payload.title: Morning in the Village
payload.text: Ananya woke up early in her village home. The morning was cool and birds were singing. She helped Grandmother light the kitchen fire before getting ready for the day.
payload.problem: she woke up early to help Grandmother

payload.title: Washing the Face
payload.text: Ravi woke up still feeling very sleepy. He went to the tap and splashed cold water on his face. The cool water woke him up and made him feel fresh for the day.
payload.problem: he had to wash his sleepy face

payload.title: Reaching On Time
payload.text: Anjali walked fast towards her school gate. The first bell had not yet rung. She reached just in time and went into her class with a happy smile.
payload.problem: she had to reach before the bell

payload.title: Combing the Hair
payload.text: Sneha got ready in front of the mirror at home. Her hair was messy after sleeping. She combed it neatly and tied two plaits before putting on her uniform.
payload.problem: her hair was messy and needed combing

payload.title: Lost Spoon
payload.text: During the lunch break at school, Ravi opened his tiffin box and found rice and curry. But he could not find his spoon, so he asked a friend to lend him one.
payload.problem: Ravi could not find his spoon

payload.title: Mother's Rice
payload.text: Priya came home very hungry after school. Mother had made warm rice and dal for her. Priya washed her hands, sat down at the table, and ate every bit happily.

payload.title: Banana Share
payload.text: At lunch break, Rohan saw that his friend had no fruit. Rohan had two bananas in his bag, so he gave one to his friend. They ate together and felt happy.

payload.title: Big Glass
payload.text: Anaya woke up feeling very thirsty at home. Mother gave her a big glass of milk. Anaya drank it slowly and then got ready for school with a smile.

payload.title: Hot Lunch
payload.text: Kabir was very hungry after playing outside. At home, Mother served hot dal and rice on his plate. Kabir blew on the hot food, then ate it slowly so it would not burn.

payload.title: Kind Diya (Medium)
payload.text: At school, Diya saw that her friend had forgotten her tiffin. Diya opened her own lunch box and gave half of it to her friend. Both girls ate together and laughed.

payload.title: Mango Treat
payload.text: Aditya saw a ripe yellow mango at home. After lunch, Grandfather cut the mango into small pieces for him. Aditya ate the sweet fruit and asked for one more piece.

payload.title: Canteen Idli
payload.text: Meera felt very hungry during her break. She went to the canteen and bought a plate of soft idli. She ate it with hot sambar and felt full and happy after.

payload.title: Chapati Roll 2
payload.text: At home, Vikram was hungry after his homework. Mother gave him two soft chapatis with curd and curry. He rolled the chapati, dipped it in curry, and ate it quickly.

payload.title: Empty Box
payload.text: At lunch break, Ishaan opened his bag and found his tiffin was empty. He had forgotten to take food at home. A friend shared some biscuits so Ishaan would not stay hungry.

payload.title: Favourite Meal
payload.text: Sara came home from school and asked for her favourite lunch. Mother gave her curd and rice in a bowl. Sara mixed it well, added a little salt, and ate it happily.

payload.title: Under the Tree
payload.text: In the village, Arjun sat under a big tree to eat his lunch. He opened his tiffin and found rice and pickle inside. A cool wind blew while he ate his meal slowly.

payload.title: Crispy Dosa
payload.text: Tara woke up early and went to the kitchen at home. Grandmother was making crispy dosa on the hot pan. Tara waited near the stove, then ate two dosas with chutney.

payload.title: Food Fell
payload.text: At school, Karan was carrying his plate to his seat. He tripped, and all his food fell on the floor with a loud sound. He felt sad, but a friend shared lunch with him.
payload.problem: Karan's food fell on the floor

payload.title: Surprise Lunch
payload.text: Riya was hungry at school and opened her tiffin during the break. Inside, she found rice with tasty curry and a sweet for dessert. She smiled because Mother had given her a surprise.

payload.title: Clean Plate
payload.text: Veer was hungry after a long day. At home, he ate rice and curry on a steel plate. After he finished, he washed his own plate and helped Mother clean the table.

payload.title: Forgot Tiffin
payload.text: Ananya rushed to school and forgot her tiffin at home. At lunch break, she felt very hungry and worried. Then a kind friend shared her food, and Ananya thanked her with a big smile.

payload.title: Bread and Jam
payload.text: Anjali was hungry during her lunch break. She went to the canteen and bought bread with sweet jam. She sat at a table near the window and ate while watching the busy yard.

payload.title: Sweet Grapes (Medium)
payload.text: At lunch break, Sneha had a box of sweet green grapes. Her friend looked at them with hungry eyes. Sneha gave her a small bunch, and the two girls ate grapes together happily.

payload.title: One More
payload.text: Aarav was very hungry after school. At home, he ate a big plate of rice and dal. The food was so tasty that he asked Mother for one more helping before he stopped.

payload.title: Window Seat (Medium)
payload.text: Ravi got on the school bus in the morning. He looked for an empty seat near the window. He found one at the back, sat down, and watched the trees move past the bus.

payload.title: Late Bus (Medium)
payload.text: Priya reached the bus stop early and waited. The bus did not come for a long time. She felt worried about being late, but at last the bus came and she got on quickly.

payload.title: Van Driver
payload.text: Rohan got into the school van in the morning. The kind driver waved and said good morning to all the children. Rohan found his seat, kept his bag down, and the van started to move.

payload.title: Buy Ticket
payload.text: Anaya rode the city bus with Mother. When the conductor came, Anaya gave him the money. The conductor gave her one ticket and the change. Anaya kept the ticket safe in her small bag.

payload.title: No Seat
payload.text: Kabir got on the bus, but it was very crowded. He walked slowly to the back, looking for a seat. At last he found one empty seat and sat down with a happy sigh.
payload.problem: Kabir could not find a seat

payload.title: Help Granny (Medium)
payload.text: Diya was sitting on the bus when an old lady got on. There were no empty seats left. Diya stood up at once and gave her seat to the old lady, who smiled kindly.
payload.problem: An old lady had no seat

payload.title: Wrong Stop
payload.text: Aditya sat on the bus and looked out of the window. He was busy watching the shops and missed his own stop. He told the conductor, who helped him get down at the next stop.

payload.title: Green Fields
payload.text: Meera went on a train trip with Mother. She sat by the window and watched the green fields and rivers go by. The train moved fast, and Meera waved at people in the small villages.

payload.title: Fast Metro
payload.text: Vikram held Father's hand on the metro platform. When the metro came, they got in quickly. Vikram looked out at the dark tunnel as the fast metro took them to the big market.

payload.title: Bumpy Road
payload.text: Ishaan rode the old village bus on a rough road. The bus shook a lot on the bumpy path. He held the seat tightly and laughed each time the bus went over a big bump.

payload.title: Busy Roads
payload.text: Sara sat by the window on the bus to school. She watched the busy roads, the shops, and the people walking past. The ride was fun, and Sara reached school feeling happy and ready.

payload.title: Just in Time
payload.text: Arjun woke up late and rushed to get ready. He ran fast to the bus stop, scared that he would miss the bus. He reached just in time and jumped on as the bus started.

payload.title: Safe Bag
payload.text: Tara got on a crowded bus with her school bag. She held the bag tight on her lap so it would not slip. When her stop came, she got down carefully without losing anything.
payload.problem: Tara had to keep her bag safe

payload.title: Pay Fare (Medium)
payload.text: Karan got on the bus and sat near the door. When the conductor came, Karan gave him some coins for the fare. The conductor gave him a ticket, and Karan kept it in his pocket.

payload.title: Wait for Van
payload.text: Riya stood at the bus stop and waited for her school van. She looked down the road again and again to see if it was coming. At last the van arrived, and Riya climbed in.

payload.title: Standing Up
payload.text: Veer got on the city bus, but every seat was taken. He could not find a seat anywhere. So he stood near the door, held the bar tightly, and rode all the way standing up.

payload.title: At the Station
payload.text: Ananya went to the railway station with Father. They waited on the platform for the train to come. Ananya watched many trains arrive and leave, and she felt excited for their own train trip.

payload.title: Wave Hand
payload.text: Anjali stood at the bus stop and saw her bus coming. She waved her hand so the driver would stop for her. The bus slowed down, the door opened, and Anjali climbed in quickly.
payload.problem: Anjali wanted the bus to stop

payload.title: On Time
payload.text: Sneha was ready early and got into the school van on time. She said hello to her friends and found her usual seat. The driver counted all the children, and then the van set off.

payload.title: First Time
payload.text: Aarav rode the city bus for the first time with Father. He felt a little nervous in the big bus. Father showed him how to hold the bar and where to get down at their stop.
payload.problem: Aarav was nervous on the bus

payload.title: Coin Drop
payload.text: Ravi got a shiny coin from Father at home. Instead of buying sweets, he dropped it into his piggy bank. He wanted to save many coins so that one day he could buy a cricket bat.

payload.title: Coin Rolled
payload.text: Priya went to the shop to buy a pencil. As she took out her coin, it slipped and rolled away. She looked under the shelves but could not find it, so she felt very sad.

payload.title: Toy Plan (Medium)
payload.text: Rohan wanted to buy a small toy car. At home, he kept his rupees safe in a box under his bed. Every week he added a few coins so that soon he would have enough money.

payload.title: Honest Anaya
payload.text: Anaya found a ten rupee note on the floor at school. She knew it was not hers and someone must have lost it. So she gave the note to her teacher, who praised her for being honest.

payload.title: Buy Veggies
payload.text: Kabir went to the market with Mother to buy vegetables. He picked tomatoes and beans and gave them to the shopkeeper. Then Kabir paid the money and helped Mother carry the heavy bag back home.
payload.problem: Kabir had to pay for vegetables

payload.title: Count Coins (Medium)
payload.text: At home, Mother had a big pile of coins to count. Diya wanted to help, so she sat down beside Mother. She made small groups of ten coins each, and counting became fast and easy.

payload.title: Get Change (Medium)
payload.text: Aditya went to the shop to buy a pen. He gave the shopkeeper a twenty rupee note. The shopkeeper gave him the pen and the right change back. Aditya counted the change before leaving the shop.

payload.title: Pocket Money (Medium)
payload.text: Every week Meera got pocket money from Father at home. This week she got a little extra for helping with the house. She decided to save half of it and buy a story book later.

payload.title: Two Coins (Medium)
payload.text: Vikram had only two coins in his pocket at home. He counted them again to be sure of the amount. He thought hard about what he could buy and decided to save them for later.

payload.title: Sweet Buy
payload.text: Ishaan went to the shop with his saved coins. He chose a packet of sweets from the shelf. He gave the money to the shopkeeper and got his sweets, which he shared with his sister at home.

payload.title: Glass Jar
payload.text: Sara wanted to buy a story book one day. At home, she kept a glass jar to save her coins. Each day she dropped one or two coins inside and watched the jar slowly fill up.

payload.title: Found and Returned
payload.text: Arjun found a folded note on the bench at school. He saw his friend looking around sadly nearby. Arjun knew it must be his friend's money, so he gave it back, and his friend thanked him a lot.
payload.problem: Arjun found his friend's lost note

payload.title: Shiny Find
payload.text: Tara was cleaning the floor at home and saw something shiny. She looked under the table and found a small coin. She showed it to Grandmother, who said she could keep it in her piggy bank.

payload.title: Banana Buy
payload.text: Karan went to the market to buy bananas for breakfast. He picked a nice bunch and gave the money to the shopkeeper. Then he put the bananas in his bag and walked back home carefully.

payload.title: Full Bank (Medium)
payload.text: Riya had been saving for many weeks at home. One day her piggy bank felt heavy and full. With Mother's help, she opened it and counted all the coins, which were enough for the toy she wanted.

payload.title: Small Bill (Medium)
payload.text: Veer went to the shop to buy a notebook. The shopkeeper told him the small bill amount. Veer counted out his coins, paid the exact money, and walked home with his new notebook held tightly.
payload.problem: Veer had to pay the bill

payload.title: Toy Car Plan
payload.text: Ananya wanted a new toy car from the shop. At home, she started saving her coins in a small box. She did not spend on sweets and added coins each day until she had enough money.
payload.problem: Ananya wanted to save for a toy

payload.title: Give It Back
payload.text: Last week Anjali had borrowed a coin from her friend. Today at school, she remembered to return it. She gave the coin back and said thank you, and her friend smiled because Anjali had not forgotten.
payload.problem: Anjali had to return the coin

payload.title: Milk Packet
payload.text: Mother asked Sneha to buy milk from the shop. Sneha took the money and walked to the nearby shop. She gave the coins to the shopkeeper, picked up a milk packet, and brought it home safely.

payload.title: First Coin
payload.text: Aarav got a new piggy bank as a gift at home. He was very happy and wanted to start saving. He took his first coin and dropped it inside, hearing it land with a soft clink.

payload.title: Hungry Dog
payload.text: Ravi was walking near home when he saw a street dog. The dog looked thin and hungry. Ravi went inside, brought some biscuits, and gave them to the dog, which ate them and wagged its tail.

payload.title: Terrace Cat
payload.text: Priya went up to the terrace to dry the clothes. There she saw a small cat sitting quietly in a corner. The cat looked at her and meowed softly, so Priya brought it a little milk.
payload.problem: Priya found a cat on the terrace

payload.title: Cheeky Monkey (Medium)
payload.text: Rohan was eating a banana at home near the balcony. Suddenly a monkey jumped onto the railing and grabbed the banana from his hand. Rohan was surprised, but he laughed at the quick and cheeky monkey.

payload.title: Cow on Road
payload.text: Anaya was walking on the village road near her house. A big cow stood right in the middle of the path. Anaya waited patiently until the cow moved aside, and then she walked past it carefully.

payload.title: Hurt Bird (Medium)
payload.text: Kabir heard a soft thump on the window at home. He looked and saw that a little bird had hit the glass and fallen down. Kabir gently picked it up and gave it some water to drink.

payload.title: Garden Parrot
payload.text: Diya went to water the plants in the garden at home. On a branch she saw a bright green parrot. The parrot tilted its head and looked at Diya, who stood very still so it would not fly away.

payload.title: Baby Calf
payload.text: Aditya visited his grandfather in the village. Near the shed, he saw a baby calf standing on wobbly legs. Aditya walked up slowly and patted its soft head, and the calf licked his hand gently.

payload.title: Wagging Tail
payload.text: Meera saw a street dog near home that looked very hungry. She brought some rice and put it on a plate for the dog. The dog ate it all quickly and wagged its tail happily at Meera.

payload.title: Tiny Kitten (Medium)
payload.text: Vikram was playing in the garden at home when he heard a soft sound. He looked and found a tiny kitten hiding under a bush. Vikram poured some milk in a bowl, and the kitten came out to drink.

payload.title: Jumping Goat
payload.text: Ishaan walked to the field near his grandfather's village. There he saw a goat jump over a small fence with ease. Ishaan laughed and clapped, and the goat kept jumping back and forth a few more times.

payload.title: Park Squirrel
payload.text: Sara was playing in the park with her friends. She saw a little squirrel run quickly up a tree trunk. The squirrel stopped, held a nut in its paws, and ate it while Sara watched in delight.

payload.title: Ball Game
payload.text: Arjun met a big friendly dog at the park. The dog wanted to play, so Arjun threw a ball far away. The dog ran fast, brought the ball back, and dropped it at Arjun's feet again and again.

payload.title: Thirsty Bird
payload.text: Tara saw a small bird sitting on the window at home on a hot day. The bird looked tired and thirsty. Tara filled a small bowl with water and kept it on the sill, and the bird drank from it.

payload.title: Shut Window
payload.text: Karan was on the terrace when he saw a monkey nearby. The monkey was looking at the open window of his house. Karan ran and shut the window quickly so the monkey would not get inside and take anything.
payload.problem: A monkey might enter the house

payload.title: Cow Stood Still
payload.text: Riya was going to the market with Mother. Near the gate, a big cow stood still and would not move. Riya and Mother waited for a while, and then they walked around the cow to reach the shops.

payload.title: Pond Ducks (Medium)
payload.text: Veer visited the village and went to the pond with Grandfather. There he saw many ducks swimming and diving in the water. Veer threw a few grains, and the ducks swam quickly towards him to eat them.
payload.problem: Veer saw ducks in the pond

payload.title: Sleeping Cat
payload.text: Ananya came home from school and went to her room. On her soft chair, a cat was sleeping peacefully. Ananya did not want to wake it up, so she sat quietly on the bed and read her book.
payload.problem: A cat was sleeping on her chair

payload.title: New Nest
payload.text: Anjali went up to the terrace and looked at the corner. There she saw a bird carrying twigs and leaves. The bird was building a small nest. Anjali watched quietly and did not disturb the busy little bird.
payload.problem: A bird was building a nest

payload.title: Lost Puppy (Medium)
payload.text: Sneha was walking near school when she heard a soft whine. She found a lost puppy sitting alone by the gate. Sneha gave it water from her bottle and told the watchman, who promised to take care of it.

payload.title: Funny Parrot
payload.text: Aarav was sitting outside in the village when he heard a loud sound. It was a parrot calling from a tall tree. Aarav tried to copy the funny sound, and the parrot seemed to answer him back loudly.

payload.title: Tall Lego Tower
payload.text: Ravi sat on the floor at home with his box of lego. He wanted to build the tallest tower ever. He kept adding blocks one by one, and soon the tower almost touched the table lamp above.
payload.problem: Ravi wanted to build a tall tower

payload.title: Big Castle
payload.text: Priya went to the park with wet sand near the swings. She wanted to make a big sand castle. She used a small bucket to shape the walls and put a tiny flag on top when she was done.
payload.problem: Priya wanted to make a castle

payload.title: Brick by Brick
payload.text: Rohan stood near the building site close to his house. He watched the workers put bricks one on top of another. A new wall was slowly growing taller. Rohan wondered how high the new building would become.

payload.title: Doll Wall
payload.text: Anaya sat on the floor at home with her toy bricks. She wanted to make a strong wall for her dolls. She stacked the bricks carefully so they would not fall, and soon a neat little wall stood ready.
payload.problem: Anaya wanted to build a wall

payload.title: Cool Mud House
payload.text: Kabir went to the village with his family. There he saw a small mud house with a roof made of dry grass. Grandfather told him that mud houses stay cool inside, even when it is very hot outside.

payload.title: Cracked Wall
payload.text: Diya was walking in the school playground when she saw a wall with a big crack. The broken wall looked unsafe to her. She quickly went and told her teacher, who kept all the children away from it.

payload.title: Lift to Terrace
payload.text: Aditya wanted to go up to the terrace at home. He stepped into the lift and pressed the top button. The lift went up smoothly, the doors opened, and Aditya walked out onto the bright open terrace.
payload.problem: Aditya wanted to reach the terrace

payload.title: Watchman Room (Medium)
payload.text: Meera passed the small room near the gate at home. It was the watchman's room, with a chair and a fan inside. She said good morning to the watchman, who smiled and waved at her kindly.

payload.title: View from Top
payload.text: Vikram climbed up to the terrace of his building. From up there he could see many tall buildings around him. He looked down at the tiny cars and people below, and the cool wind blew on his face.

payload.title: Block House
payload.text: Ishaan sat at home with a big box of toy blocks. He wanted to build a house with a door for his toy cars. He made a wall with a small gate for the cars.
payload.problem: Ishaan wanted to build a house

payload.title: Sand Tunnel
payload.text: Sara was at the park where there was a heap of soft sand. She dug a deep hole with her hands. Then she made a small tunnel through the sand and pushed a tiny toy car through it happily.
payload.problem: Sara wanted to dig in the sand

payload.title: Farmer's Hut
payload.text: Arjun walked through the village fields with Grandfather. At the edge of a field, he saw a small hut. A kind farmer kept his tools inside the hut and rested there during the hot afternoon, said Grandfather.

payload.title: Try Again
payload.text: Tara was building a brick tower at home. Just as it grew tall, the whole tower fell down with a crash. Tara felt sad for a moment, but then she smiled and began to build it all over again.

payload.title: Yellow Crane
payload.text: Karan stood near the building site and looked up high. A big yellow crane was lifting heavy bricks to the top floor. Karan watched the crane move slowly and carefully, and he thought the machine was very strong.

payload.title: Count Windows
payload.text: Riya saw a new house being built near her home. Every day a little more of it was finished. One morning she counted all the windows on the front and found there were eight windows in two neat rows.
payload.problem: Riya saw a new house being built

payload.title: Tall Ladder (Medium)
payload.text: Veer went near the building site with Father. He saw a very tall ladder leaning against the wall. A worker climbed up the ladder slowly with a bucket of paint. Veer watched and hoped the man would be safe.
payload.problem: Veer saw a worker on a ladder

payload.title: Fixing the Gate
payload.text: Ananya came home and saw a big pile of bricks near the gate. Some workers were fixing the broken gate of the building. Ananya stayed away from the bricks and watched the workers mix cement and lay them neatly.

payload.title: Grass Roof Hut
payload.text: Anjali visited the village with Grandmother. She saw a small hut with a roof made of dry grass. Anjali liked its simple look and asked many questions. Grandmother said such huts have been built for many years.
payload.problem: Anjali saw a grass roof hut

payload.title: Wait for Lift
payload.text: Sneha came home tired and did not want to climb the stairs. She pressed the button and waited for the lift. The numbers above the door slowly came down, and at last the lift arrived for Sneha.

payload.title: Little Lego Home
payload.text: Aarav spent the whole evening at home with his lego set. He wanted to build a complete house. He made walls, a roof, a door, and two windows. When he finished, he put a tiny lego family inside it.
payload.problem: Aarav wanted to build a house

payload.title: Granny's Long Story
payload.text: On the cool terrace at night, Granny told Anjali a long story about a brave girl. Anjali listened with wide eyes and asked for more.

payload.title: Library Reading Hour
payload.text: Ravi sat in the school library during the reading hour. He picked a small story book and read each page with care. The room was quiet.
payload.problem: He wanted to read a story

payload.title: Bedtime Story Time
payload.text: Mother sat near Sneha in the warm bedroom. She read a kind tale about a lost puppy. Sneha smiled and closed her eyes slowly.

payload.title: Funny Tale Time
payload.text: Aarav read a funny tale in his room. He laughed so much that his brother came in to ask why. They read it together again.

payload.title: Soft Bedtime Tale
payload.text: Father sat near Diya before bed and told her a soft tale about a kind star. She held her doll and listened with sleepy eyes.

payload.title: Sister Reads Aloud
payload.text: Big sister Anjali sat near Kabir on the sofa and read a story aloud. Kabir followed each picture with his small finger.

payload.title: Class Story Time
payload.text: Priya sat in the school story circle and listened to a teacher read a kind tale. She liked the part about the helpful boy the most.

payload.title: Brave Tale
payload.text: Veer read a brave tale in his room and felt his heart beat fast. The hero of the tale fought a big storm to save a small girl.

payload.title: Granny's Tale Time
payload.text: Granny sat on the terrace with Meera and turned the pages of a kind story book. Meera asked questions after every line.

payload.title: Moral of the Story
payload.text: Aditya heard a moral story from his class teacher. The story told him to share with his friends, even on busy days.

payload.title: New Story Book
payload.text: Tara picked a new story book from the home shelf and started reading on the soft rug. The bright pictures pulled her in.

payload.title: Hero of the Tale
payload.text: Father read Karan a hero tale before bed. The hero saved a tired old man during a big rain at night.

payload.title: Library Visit
payload.text: Sara walked into the big city library with Anaya. They both picked story books and sat in the kids' corner together.

payload.title: Funny Tale Read
payload.text: Anaya read a funny tale at home and laughed so much that Mother came to peek into the room. They read it together again.

payload.title: Big Book on Sofa
payload.text: Arjun opened a big book on the sofa and read each line slowly. He felt happy when the boy in the story found his lost dog.

payload.title: Bedtime Tale
payload.text: Mother read Ishaan a kind tale at bedtime. The tale was about a small bird that found a new home in the courtyard.

payload.title: Picture Story Book
payload.text: Riya looked at the picture story book with bright pages on her bed. She wanted to draw the small mouse from the page too.

payload.title: Granny on the Porch
payload.text: Granny sat on the porch with Vikram and read a kind story about a helpful boy. Vikram asked her to read it once more.

payload.title: Story Box at Home
payload.text: Sneha opened the story box at home and picked the tale with the bright cover. She sat with Mother and read each page.

payload.title: Father Reads to Anjali
payload.text: Father sat on the sofa and read a kind tale aloud to Anjali. She held her doll and listened with a small smile.

payload.title: Society Pool Splash
payload.text: Ravi jumped into the society pool and made a big splash. His cousin Aarav joined him from the side and splashed back.

payload.title: First Swim Lesson
payload.text: Anjali had her very first swim lesson at the school pool. The coach showed her how to float and Anjali tried hard.

payload.title: Big Puddle Splash
payload.text: Diya saw a big puddle on the lane after the rain. She jumped right in and made a big splash that wet her shoes.

payload.title: River Bath in Village
payload.text: Aarav had a long bath in the village river with Uncle. The water was cool and the stones were smooth under his feet.

payload.title: Bucket Splash Game
payload.text: Sneha filled a small bucket at the porch tap and tipped it on her cousin. They laughed and ran to fill it again together.

payload.title: Garden Water Bag
payload.text: Kabir threw a soft water bag at his cousin in the garden. The bag burst and water flew in all directions. Both boys laughed.

payload.title: School Pool Joy
payload.text: Priya jumped into the school pool with her three friends. They played a soft tag game in the shallow end of the pool.

payload.title: Quiet Village Pond
payload.text: Veer sat by the quiet village pond and dipped his toes in the cool water. A small fish slipped past his foot.

payload.title: Long Bath Time
payload.text: Meera filled the bath bucket and took a long, happy bath at home. She poured water on her head with a small mug.

payload.title: Waves at the Beach
payload.text: Aditya saw the waves at the beach for the very first time. He held Father's hand as the water rushed up to his ankles.

payload.title: Soft Water Bag Burst
payload.text: Tara opened a soft water bag in the courtyard with her cousin. The water burst out and they ran around laughing in circles.

payload.title: Pool Race Win
payload.text: Karan won a short pool race against his cousin Veer at the society pool. He cheered and splashed water with both hands.

payload.title: Long Pool Play
payload.text: Sara splashed in the pool for a long time with her cousin. They made a small water wall by kicking together near the wall.

payload.title: Big Bucket Splash
payload.text: Anaya tipped a big bucket on her own head at the porch tap. She laughed loudly and went to fill it once more.

payload.title: Wave Watch with Father
payload.text: Arjun watched the slow waves with Father at the beach. They held shells in their hands and counted each big wave.

payload.title: Garden Tap Splash
payload.text: Ishaan splashed water at the garden tap and got his shirt wet. Mother came out and asked him to be a bit careful.

payload.title: Pool Float Time
payload.text: Riya floated on a soft tube in the society pool. She let her hands drift on the water as the sun shone bright above.

payload.title: Village Tap Splash
payload.text: Vikram splashed his hands at the village tap and laughed. His shirt got a little wet but he did not mind at all.

payload.title: Bath Bucket Fun
payload.text: Anjali poured the bath bucket on her own head at home. The water was warm and she sang a small song while she did it.
