payload.problem: A puppy was lost and alone

payload.title: The Parrot That Replied
payload.text: Aarav was sitting outside in the village one quiet afternoon when he heard a loud, sharp sound. He looked up and saw a bright parrot calling from the top of a tall tree. For fun, Aarav tried to copy the funny sound that the parrot was making.

payload.title: The Tallest Tower
payload.text: Ravi sat down on the floor at home with his big box of colourful lego blocks. He had decided to build the tallest tower he had ever made. He carefully placed one block on top of another, making sure each one was straight.
payload.problem: Ravi wanted to build a tall tower

payload.title: The Sand Castle
payload.text: Priya went to the park where there was a big pile of soft, wet sand near the swings. She really wanted to build a grand sand castle. She used a small bucket to shape the walls and pressed the sand firmly so it would not crumble.
payload.problem: Priya wanted to make a sand castle

payload.title: Watching the Builders
payload.text: Rohan stood near the building site that was close to his house. He loved to watch the workers at their job. They picked up bricks and placed them one on top of another, joining them with grey cement. A new wall was slowly growing taller every day.

payload.title: A Wall for the Dolls
payload.text: Anaya sat down on the floor at home with her box of toy bricks. She wanted to build a strong wall to make a little house for her dolls. She stacked the bricks one on top of another, being very careful so that they would not topple over.
payload.problem: Anaya wanted to build a wall

payload.title: The Cool Mud House
payload.text: Kabir went to the village with his family during the summer holidays. While walking around, he came across a small mud house with a roof made of dry grass. Kabir was curious about why anyone would build a house from mud.

payload.title: The Cracked Wall
payload.text: Diya was walking across the school playground during the break when something caught her eye. She saw a wall with a big crack running down the middle of it. The broken wall looked weak and unsafe, as if it might fall at any time.

payload.title: Up to the Terrace
payload.text: Aditya wanted to go up to the terrace of his building to fly his new kite. Instead of climbing the many stairs, he decided to take the lift. He stepped inside, pressed the button for the top floor, and waited. The lift moved up smoothly, and soon the doors slid open.
payload.problem: Aditya wanted to reach the terrace

payload.title: The Watchman's Room
payload.text: Meera was leaving for school when she passed the small room near the main gate of her building. It was the watchman's room, and inside it had a wooden chair, a small table, and a fan whirring slowly. The friendly watchman was sitting there, keeping an eye on everyone who came and went.

payload.title: The View from the Top
payload.text: Vikram climbed all the way up to the terrace of his tall building one evening. From up there, he could see many other tall buildings standing all around him. He looked down at the road far below, where the cars and people looked as tiny as toys.

payload.title: A House for Toy Cars
payload.text: Ishaan sat at home with a big box of toy building blocks spread out around him. He wanted to make a small house with a door big enough for his toy cars to drive through. He worked carefully, building the walls one by one.
payload.problem: Ishaan wanted to build a house

payload.title: Digging a Tunnel
payload.text: Sara was at the park, where there was a large heap of soft, cool sand near the slide. She began to dig a deep hole using both of her hands. After a while, she had an idea and started to dig from the other side too.
payload.problem: Sara wanted to dig a tunnel

payload.title: The Farmer's Hut
payload.text: Arjun walked through the wide village fields with Grandfather on a sunny morning. At the edge of one field, he noticed a small hut made of mud and wood. Arjun wondered who it belonged to. Grandfather explained that a farmer kept his tools inside the hut and rested there during the hot afternoon, away from the sun.

payload.title: Build It Again
payload.text: Tara was busy building a tall tower with her toy bricks at home. She added block after block, and the tower grew taller and taller. But just as it reached its highest point, the whole tower wobbled and fell down with a loud crash.

payload.title: The Big Yellow Crane
payload.text: Karan stood near the building site and looked high up into the sky. There he saw a tall yellow crane lifting a heavy load of bricks all the way up to the top floor of the new building. He watched the crane swing slowly and carefully, placing the bricks exactly where the workers needed them.
payload.problem: Karan watched a crane lift bricks

payload.title: Counting the Windows
payload.text: Riya watched a new house slowly being built near her home over many days. Every morning, a little more of the house seemed to be finished. One day, out of curiosity, she decided to count all the windows on the front of the house.
payload.problem: Riya saw a new house being built

payload.title: The Worker on the Ladder
payload.text: Veer went near the building site with Father one afternoon. He noticed a very tall ladder leaning against the side of the new building. As he watched, a worker began to climb up the ladder slowly, carrying a bucket of white paint in one hand.
payload.problem: Veer saw a worker on a tall ladder

payload.title: Fixing the Gate (Hard)
payload.text: Ananya came home from school and noticed a big pile of bricks lying near the main gate of her building. Some workers were busy fixing the old broken gate. Ananya knew she should not go too close to the bricks and tools, so she stood at a safe distance to watch.

payload.title: The Grass Roof Hut
payload.text: Anjali visited the village with Grandmother during the school holidays. While they walked along a quiet path, she saw a small hut with a roof made entirely of dry grass. Anjali had never seen such a house before and liked its simple look very much.
payload.problem: Anjali saw a grass roof hut

payload.title: Waiting for the Lift
payload.text: Sneha came home feeling very tired after a long day at school. She did not want to climb all the stairs up to her flat. So she pressed the button to call the lift and stood waiting in front of the doors. She watched the floor numbers above the door slowly count down one by one.

payload.title: A Complete Lego House
payload.text: Aarav spent the whole evening at home playing with his big lego set. He had set himself a goal to build a complete house, not just a wall. He carefully made the four walls, then added a sloping roof, a front door, and two small windows.
payload.problem: Aarav wanted to build a complete house

payload.title: Granny's Long Bedtime Story
payload.text: On a cool winter night, Anjali sat with Granny on the warm terrace under a soft blanket. Granny told a long story about a brave village girl who saved her small puppy from a rainy night.

payload.title: Ravi's Library Hour
payload.text: Ravi sat in the school library during the quiet reading hour. He picked a small story book from the kids shelf and read each page with full care. The room was so quiet that he could hear the slow ceiling fan.
payload.problem: He wanted to read a story

payload.title: Mother's Bedtime Story
payload.text: Mother sat near Sneha in the warm bedroom and read a kind tale about a lost puppy who found a new home. Sneha smiled, hugged her doll, and closed her eyes slowly as the story moved to the end.

payload.title: Aarav's Funny Tale
payload.text: Aarav read a funny tale in his small room after lunch. He laughed so much that his big brother came in to ask what was so funny. They both sat on the bed and read the tale once again, line by line.

payload.title: Father's Soft Tale
payload.text: Father sat near Diya before bed and told her a soft tale about a kind star who helped lost children find their way home. Diya held her doll close and listened with sleepy eyes till the very end.

payload.title: Sister Reads to Kabir
payload.text: Big sister Anjali sat next to Kabir on the soft sofa and read a story aloud about a brave bird. Kabir followed each picture with his small finger and asked what every new word in the book meant.

payload.title: School Story Circle
payload.text: Priya sat in the school story circle on the soft red mat and listened to her teacher read a tale about a helpful boy from a small village. She liked the part where the boy shared his lunch with a hungry friend.

payload.title: Veer's Brave Tale
payload.text: Veer read a brave tale in his room and felt his small heart beat fast. The hero of the tale fought a big storm to save a small girl from her wet boat. Veer closed the book and let out a long breath.

payload.title: Granny on the Terrace
payload.text: Granny sat on the cool terrace with Meera and turned the bright pages of a kind story book. Meera asked her so many small questions after every line that Granny had to stop and smile at her sweet voice.

payload.title: Aditya's Moral Story
payload.text: Aditya heard a moral story from his class teacher about a boy who shared his lunch with a friend who had none. The story told him to be kind even on busy and tiring school days when no one is watching.

payload.title: New Book on Shelf
payload.text: Tara picked a new story book from the top home shelf and started reading on the soft, warm rug. The bright pictures pulled her into a new world full of birds, kind kids, and a small smiling moon.

payload.title: Father's Hero Tale
payload.text: Father sat next to Karan in bed and read a hero tale aloud. The hero saved a tired old man during a heavy rain at night. Karan was so happy that he asked Father to read it just one more time.

payload.title: City Library Visit
payload.text: Sara walked into the big city library with her cousin Anaya. They both picked colourful story books from the kids corner and sat on the soft blue chairs near the window to read till Mother came back for them.

payload.title: Funny Tale at Home
payload.text: Anaya read a funny tale at home on the soft rug and laughed so much that Mother came to peek into her room. They sat together and read the same tale once more so Mother could laugh too at the funny part.

payload.title: Arjun on the Sofa
payload.text: Arjun opened a big book on the sofa and read each line slowly with full focus. He felt very happy when the small boy in the story finally found his lost dog after a long search through the busy town.

payload.title: Tale Before Sleep
payload.text: Mother sat near Ishaan in bed and read a kind tale at bedtime. The tale was about a small bird that found a new warm home in the courtyard after the cold and rainy winter days had finally come to an end.

payload.title: Picture Book Read
payload.text: Riya looked at the picture story book with bright pages on her soft, warm bed. The small mouse in the story made her laugh and she said she wanted to draw the same mouse on her drawing pad later in the evening.

payload.title: Granny Reads on Porch
payload.text: Granny sat on the cool, breezy porch with Vikram and read a kind story about a helpful boy from a small mountain village. Vikram listened with full eyes and then asked her to read the same lovely tale once more.

payload.title: Sneha's Story Box
payload.text: Sneha opened the small story box at home and picked the tale with the brightest cover she could see. She sat with Mother on the floor and read each page slowly to make the small joy of the tale last longer.

payload.title: Father Reads on Sofa
payload.text: Father sat on the long sofa and read a kind tale aloud to Anjali after dinner. She held her favourite doll and listened with a small soft smile till the story moved to the happy end where everyone became friends.

payload.title: Big Society Pool Splash
payload.text: Ravi jumped into the cool society pool and made a big splash that wet his cousin Aarav. Aarav laughed and splashed him back from the side. Both of them played a soft water tag near the shallow end for a long time.

payload.title: Anjali's First Lesson
payload.text: Anjali had her very first swim lesson at the school pool on a sunny day. The kind coach showed her how to float on her back and how to kick her legs slowly. Anjali tried hard and felt very proud at the end of the class.

payload.title: Big Lane Puddle
payload.text: Diya saw a big puddle on the lane after the long rain. She jumped right in and made a big splash that wet her school shoes and her socks. Mother smiled and asked her to come home and change her wet clothes quickly.

payload.title: River Bath with Uncle
payload.text: Aarav had a long, happy bath in the village river with Uncle on a warm afternoon. The water was cool and the round, smooth stones felt soft under his small feet. He saw small fish swim past his ankles slowly.

payload.title: Porch Bucket Game
payload.text: Sneha filled a small bucket at the porch tap and tipped it on her cousin's head. They both laughed loudly and ran back to fill the bucket once more together. The porch floor became very wet and they had to clean it up.

payload.title: Garden Water Bag Game
payload.text: Kabir threw a soft water bag at his cousin in the garden during the summer holidays. The bag burst on his cousin's back and water flew in all directions. Both boys laughed and started filling new water bags for the next round.

payload.title: Pool Joy with Friends
payload.text: Priya jumped into the school pool with her three close friends after the swim coach blew the whistle. They played a soft tag game in the shallow end and then floated on their backs side by side under the bright noon sun.

payload.title: Pond in the Village
payload.text: Veer sat by the quiet village pond and slowly dipped his small toes in the cool water. A small fish slipped past his foot and he let out a small soft laugh. Uncle sat next to him and read a quiet news paper on the bench.

payload.title: Long Happy Bath
payload.text: Meera filled the bath bucket and took a long, happy bath at home after a hot summer day. She poured warm water on her head with a small mug and sang a soft song to her doll that sat on the side of the bath.

payload.title: Beach Waves First Time
payload.text: Aditya saw the waves at the sea beach for the very first time. He held Father's strong hand tightly as the small white waves rushed up to his ankles. He picked up a smooth, round shell to take back home to show Mother.

payload.title: Courtyard Water Bag
payload.text: Tara opened a soft water bag in the courtyard with her cousin on a hot summer day. The water burst out and they ran around the courtyard laughing in big, happy circles till Mother called them in for a glass of cold drink.

payload.title: Society Pool Race
payload.text: Karan won a short pool race against his cousin Veer at the society pool. He cheered loudly and splashed water with both hands as he reached the wall first. Veer laughed too and asked for one more race after a small rest.

payload.title: Long Pool Play
payload.text: Sara splashed in the cool pool for a long time with her cousin on a bright sunny day. They both made a small water wall by kicking their legs together near the side of the pool, and then made a tall castle on the wet floor.

payload.title: Big Bucket on Head
payload.text: Anaya tipped a big bucket on her own head at the porch tap on a hot afternoon. She laughed loudly as the cool water ran down her hair and back. She went straight to fill the bucket up once more for one more splash.

payload.title: Wave Watch with Father
payload.text: Arjun watched the slow waves at the sea beach with Father on a warm evening. They both held smooth round shells in their hands and counted each big wave that broke on the wet sand near their bare and very happy small feet.

payload.title: Garden Tap Splash
payload.text: Ishaan splashed water at the garden tap and got his cotton shirt fully wet on the hot afternoon. Mother came out to the porch and asked him to be a little careful so that he would not slip on the wet, slippery garden tiles.

payload.title: Pool Float on Tube
payload.text: Riya floated on a bright soft tube in the society pool on a calm and bright sunny day. She let her small hands drift on top of the cool water as the warm sun shone bright above her face and dried her cheeks slowly.

payload.title: Village Tap Game
payload.text: Vikram splashed his hands at the village tap with his cousin and laughed loudly. His blue shirt got a little wet but he did not mind at all. Uncle smiled and said the cool water was good to play with on such a hot summer day.

payload.title: Anjali's Bath Time
payload.text: Anjali poured the bath bucket on her own head at home after a long day of play. The water was warm and she sang a soft song to her doll while she splashed her small feet in the bath water. Mother smiled at her from the door.

payload.title: Ravi at the River
payload.text: Ravi went to the village river with Uncle for a fun swim on a warm and bright afternoon. The water was cool and the small fish moved around his small feet. He splashed Uncle once and they both laughed loudly under the open sky.

payload.title: Cold Day at Home
payload.text: On a cold December day, Sneha wore a thick wool sweater and a soft pink wool cap. She still felt the chill in her hands and ran inside to the warm kitchen, where Mother held her hands and rubbed them slowly to warm them up.

payload.title: Foggy Road to Van
payload.text: Ravi could barely see the foggy road from the front gate of the building. He held Father's strong hand tightly as they walked slowly to the school van stop. The fog was so thick that the street lights looked like small yellow balls.

payload.title: Hot Milk Glass Time
payload.text: Anjali drank a hot milk glass in the warm bright kitchen on a cold winter morning. Her small hands felt very cold and she held the warm glass tightly to warm them up before she stepped out to the cold porch for her bus.

payload.title: Wool Cap and Scarf
payload.text: Aarav wore a thick wool cap, a long scarf, and his warm new gloves for a cold morning walk to the bus stop. His small nose still felt very cold and he ran back home to ask Mother for a small cup of warm milk before school.

payload.title: Quilt and Story Book
payload.text: Diya hugged the warm quilt and stayed in the bed all morning during the winter holidays. Mother said she could read her new story book and have warm milk under the quilt. Diya smiled and turned the bright pages slowly.

payload.title: First Snow in Hills
payload.text: Kabir saw real soft white snow for the very first time on a trip to the cool hills with his family. He scooped a small round ball of snow and showed it to his big sister, who laughed and made a small snowman with him on the path.

payload.title: Pink Coat to School
payload.text: Priya wore her new pink coat to school for the very first time on a cold morning. The other kids in the bus said the coat looked very nice and she felt very happy. She wore the coat the whole day, even inside the warm class.

payload.title: Slow Foggy Lane
payload.text: Veer walked very slowly in the foggy lane near the front gate on a cold morning. He held Father's strong hand and could only see a few small steps ahead of him. The road lights looked like soft yellow balls in the thick fog.

payload.title: Tea on the Terrace
payload.text: Mother gave Meera a small warm tea cup on the cold terrace one foggy morning. They sat side by side on the wooden bench and watched the fog lift slowly from the sleepy city below them. Meera felt very warm and very loved.

payload.title: Red Scarf Walk
payload.text: Aditya tied a soft red scarf around his neck and stepped out to play with his friends in the park. The cold wind blew strong and he was very glad about the scarf, which kept his small chest and neck very warm during the long game.

payload.title: Lazy Quilt Morning
payload.text: Tara stayed under a warm soft blanket all morning during the winter holidays and read her new story book with bright pages. Mother brought her a small warm cup of milk in bed and Tara felt very cosy and very lucky on the cold day.

payload.title: Snow Day in Hills
payload.text: Karan wore a thick snow hat and warm gloves at the hill station on a bright snowy day. He made a small smiling snowman with his big sister near the road. The snow was soft and white and it stayed in big patches on the road sides.

payload.title: Brown Coat Morning
payload.text: Sara wore a warm brown coat on a cold winter morning before she stepped out for school. She also wore her warm gloves and a soft yellow wool cap that her grandmother had made for her in the village last winter holiday.

payload.title: Misty Park View
payload.text: Anaya could barely see the misty park bench from her seat at the window on a cold morning. The whole city looked like it was wrapped in soft cloud. She drew a small smiling face on the foggy glass and showed it to her little brother.

payload.title: Hot Drink for Arjun
payload.text: Arjun had a small hot drink at home before he stepped out to the cold bus stop on a foggy morning. His hands felt warm again and his small cheeks turned a soft pink. He waved to Mother from the gate as the school bus came in.

payload.title: Pink Scarf Gift Day
payload.text: Ishaan got a soft pink wool scarf from Aunt last week and wore it on the cold walk to the school van stop today. He felt very warm under the scarf and his big brother told him that pink was a very brave colour to wear to school.

payload.title: Quilt and Book Day
payload.text: Riya read her new story book under the warm quilt all afternoon during the winter holidays. The room was warm and bright and she had a small cup of hot milk on the side table. She turned the bright pages slowly and smiled.

payload.title: Mountain Trip with Family
payload.text: Vikram went on a big mountain trip with his whole family during the school holidays. He saw soft white snow on the trees and on the road sides. He made a small snowman with his sister and felt very happy as he played in the cool snow.

payload.title: Warm Layer for Van
payload.text: Anjali put on a thick warm layer at home before the school van came on a cold foggy morning. She also wore her soft wool cap and her warm blue gloves. Mother kissed her cheek and waved at her from the gate as the van pulled away.

payload.title: Hot Soup After School
payload.text: Ravi had a hot soup bowl at home after he came back from school on a cold winter day. The warm soup made his cold hands and his small face feel much better. Mother sat near him and told him a small joke that made him laugh.

payload.title: Sweet Mango at Porch
payload.text: Sneha got a sweet ripe mango from the kitchen for her lunch on a hot summer afternoon. She sat on the cool porch and ate the mango slice by slice with a small fork. The mango juice ran down her fingers and she laughed.

payload.title: Shop Ice Cream Walk
payload.text: Ravi had a cold ice cream at the local shop after a long, hot walk back from the park. The bright orange cone made him very happy and he ate it fast before it could drip down on his school uniform shirt under the warm sun.

payload.title: Hot Afternoon Porch
payload.text: Anjali stayed in the cool shade of the porch on a very hot summer afternoon. Mother brought her a big glass of cold lemon water with a slice of fresh lemon on top. The cold drink made her feel cool and fresh from the inside.

payload.title: Cool Mango Tree Spot
payload.text: Aarav sat under the big mango tree in the courtyard for a small bit of cool shade. The wide green leaves moved softly in the warm summer wind and the small mangoes on the branches looked like bright yellow gifts hanging in the air.

payload.title: Cold Lemon for Diya
payload.text: Diya drank a big glass of cold lemon water after she came home from school. Mother had kept the glass ready on the kitchen table with a small slice of fresh lemon on top. She drank it slowly and felt very cool from the inside.

payload.title: Kabir's Mango Bowl
payload.text: Kabir got a big mango bowl from Mother in the bright kitchen on a hot summer day. He sat at the small wooden table and ate it slowly with a tiny silver fork. He saved the last sweet slice for his big brother to eat after the bath.

payload.title: AC Mall Cold Treat
payload.text: Priya had a cold treat at the AC mall after a long, hot day of school and shopping. The big AC and the cold sweet treat made her feel very new again. She sat with Mother near the fountain and smiled as the cold air dried her face.

payload.title: Sunny Field Play
payload.text: Veer played in the bright sunny field till his small cheeks turned a soft, warm red. His big sister called him in for a glass of cold lemon water before he could play even more in the sun and tire himself out by the end of the day.

payload.title: Meera in Garden Shade
payload.text: Meera sat in the cool shade of the garden umbrella and sipped a big glass of lemon juice. The big umbrella kept the bright summer sun off her face all afternoon. She read her new story book and felt very happy in the cool shade.

payload.title: Aditya's Cold Drink
payload.text: Aditya had a tall glass of cold drink at home after the long, hot walk back from school. His school uniform shirt was wet with sweat and his face was a soft red colour. He drank the cold drink in one go and asked for one more.

payload.title: Tara's Mango Pulp
payload.text: Tara loved the sweet mango pulp bowl Mother made at home on a hot summer day. She ate it slowly with a small spoon and saved the very last bit to enjoy at the end. The mango pulp was bright yellow and very sweet and very fresh.

payload.title: Park Cone Treat
payload.text: Karan held a tall, cool cone treat in the park near home on a hot summer day. The ice cream began to drip down the side of the cone and he licked it fast in the bright sun. His big sister laughed and gave him a small tissue to wipe.

payload.title: Bright Sun on Porch
payload.text: Sara saw bright sunshine on the white porch wall on a hot summer afternoon. She made small shapes with her hand and watched the soft shadows dance on the white wall. Mother came out with a small cool glass of lemon water for her.

payload.title: Anaya Under Umbrella
payload.text: Anaya found a cool spot under the big garden umbrella on a hot summer day. She put her favourite doll on the small bench next to her and read her new story book in the cool shade. She felt very calm and happy in the cool spot.

payload.title: Arjun's Lemon Glass
payload.text: Arjun gulped a big glass of cold lemon water at home after he came back from play in the field. He felt very cool from the inside out and asked Mother for one more glass. Mother smiled and made a fresh glass with a slice of lemon.

payload.title: Mango with Rice Lunch
payload.text: Ishaan ate a sweet mango slice with rice and dal for lunch on a hot summer day. He saved the very last slice to eat at the very end of the meal. Mother smiled at him and gave him one more small slice from her plate as a sweet treat.

payload.title: Riya's Choco Treat
payload.text: Riya had a big choco treat at the small shop after school. She held the cone with care so it would not drip on her school uniform skirt. Her best friend Tara had a vanilla cone next to her and they both giggled as they ate slowly.

payload.title: Vikram on Hot Road
payload.text: Vikram walked under the bright hot sun to the bus stop on a hot summer day. He held his school bag over his head to make a small bit of shade for his face. The road felt very hot under his small feet and he walked very fast.

payload.title: Park Bench Shade
payload.text: Anjali found a shady bench under a big park tree and sat down to rest from the heat. The wide green leaves blocked the hot afternoon sun very well and a cool breeze came through. She felt very calm and read her book for a long time.

payload.title: Ravi's Cool Glass
payload.text: Ravi had a cool glass of lemon water at home and felt very fresh again. Mother added a small drop of honey to make it sweet. He sat on the kitchen stool and drank it slowly while he told Mother all about his day at school and play.

payload.title: First Rain Drops
payload.text: Sneha opened her bright pink umbrella for the first rain of the season on the way home from the bus stop. The big drops made a soft tap-tap sound on top of the umbrella and she felt very happy as she walked through the small puddles.

payload.title: Rain on the Window
payload.text: Ravi watched the rain hit the bedroom window for a very long time on a wet afternoon. The big round drops slid down the glass in slow lines and he made small drawings on the foggy window with his small finger as the rain came down.

payload.title: Loud Thunder Hide
payload.text: Anjali heard loud thunder and hid under her bed with her favourite doll. Mother came and sat near her on the floor and held her hand tightly till the loud sound passed. Anjali felt safe in Mother's arms and the storm did not seem so bad.

payload.title: Paper Boat in Lane
payload.text: Aarav made a small paper boat with Father at home and went out to let it float in the lane puddle. The small boat moved slowly with the small flow of rain water and Aarav clapped his hands when the boat went past the gate.

payload.title: Wet Shoes to Van
payload.text: Diya's school shoes got fully wet on the way to the school van stop on a rainy morning. Mother dried them with a soft cloth when she got home in the evening and put them near the warm window so they could be ready for school.

payload.title: Kabir Watches Rain
payload.text: Kabir watched the falling rain from his bedroom window for over an hour on a wet afternoon. He counted the small lightning flashes in his small note book and made a chart of the loud thunder times to show his class teacher at school.

payload.title: Loud Storm in Sky
payload.text: Priya hid in her bedroom when the loud storm came over the building. Her cat sat near her feet on the soft rug and they both listened to the rain together. Mother came in with a warm cup of milk and sat next to her till it stopped.

payload.title: Blue Raincoat Walk
payload.text: Veer wore his blue raincoat to the school van stop on a wet morning. He also wore his rain boots and held a small umbrella over his school bag. The rain came down hard and he was very glad he wore the warm raincoat that day.

payload.title: Meera's Wet Hair
payload.text: Meera came home with wet hair after the school bus dropped her at the front gate of the building. Mother gave her a soft, warm towel and a glass of warm milk. Meera changed into dry clothes and felt very cosy on the wet evening.

payload.title: Big Lightning Flash
payload.text: Aditya saw a big bright lightning flash in the dark cloud over the building. He counted slowly to ten and then heard the loud rumble of thunder. He marked the time in his note book and went back to his story book on the soft sofa.

payload.title: Pink Umbrella to Stop
payload.text: Tara held a bright pink umbrella on the way to the school bus stop on a rainy morning. The wind tried to flip the umbrella but she held the handle very tight. She also wore her rain boots and felt very brave on the long wet walk.

payload.title: Karan's Wet Van
payload.text: Karan's school van got fully wet in the heavy rain on the way to school. The driver had to wipe the seats with a small cloth before all the kids could sit. The trip to school was slow but Karan looked out at the wet city the whole time.

payload.title: Sara Stays Inside
payload.text: Sara stayed inside as the loud storm rolled over the building. She read her favourite story book and sipped a warm cup of milk. Father sat next to her on the sofa and told her small fun stories from his school days till the storm passed.

payload.title: Anaya's New Umbrella
payload.text: Anaya got a bright new umbrella from Mother that morning before school. She could not wait for the rain to start so she could try the new umbrella on the way home. By the time school was over, the sky was grey and the rain had started to fall.

payload.title: Mud Path Splash
payload.text: Arjun made a big mud splash on the village mud path during the holidays. His shoes got fully brown but he laughed and kept on going. Uncle called him to come back and wash his shoes at the village tap before he stepped into the house.

payload.title: Watchman at Gate
payload.text: The watchman closed the society gate as the loud storm grew louder. He waved at the kids and told them to go inside the building fast. The kids ran up the stairs and the watchman pulled his small chair into his small room to wait out the storm.

payload.title: Riya in Wet Lane
payload.text: Riya walked with a soft pink umbrella down the wet lane to her home after school. The lane had small puddles and she stepped over each one. The rain came down softly and she felt very happy as she splashed her boots in the larger ones.

payload.title: Drizzle from Van
payload.text: Vikram felt a light drizzle on his small face as he stepped out of the school van. He held his school bag over his head and ran to the gate. The rain made a soft tap-tap sound on the bag and his small school shoes splashed in a small puddle.

payload.title: Anjali at Window
payload.text: Anjali saw a big bright lightning flash at night from her bedroom window. The whole sky lit up for a small second and then everything went back to dark. She held her doll tight and waited for the loud thunder rumble to come right after.

payload.title: Yellow Raincoat to Bus
payload.text: Ravi wore a bright yellow raincoat and skipped down the road to the school bus stop on a rainy morning. The rain drops bounced off his hood with a soft tap-tap sound. He sang a small song under his breath as he skipped to the bus stop.

payload.title: Slide Race HPG
payload.text: Aarav and Karan were racing down the two slides at the society playground every evening. On Friday Aarav reached the bottom first and laughed loudly. They climbed up to play again, but this time Karan let his small brother go before them. Aarav clapped and said it was a kind thing.
payload.problem: Aarav and Karan raced on the slide

payload.title: Wall Ball
payload.text: Priya kicked the football very hard during the school playground match and the ball went straight over the high wall. She called the watchman and explained where it had landed. The watchman walked to the other side and rolled it back to her. Priya thanked him and her team got back to playing.
payload.problem: Priya kicked the ball over the wall

payload.title: Brave Swing
payload.text: Rohan went very high on the swing at the society playground and felt scared because his hands were slipping. His friend told him to hold tight and slow his legs. Rohan calmed himself and slowly came down safely. He said he would still try the swing again next time.
payload.problem: Rohan was scared on the high swing

payload.title: Sand Tower HPG
payload.text: Diya and Meera worked together to build a sand tower at the playground. A small kid ran past and broke it by mistake. Both girls felt sad for a moment but Diya said it was an accident. They started again and made an even bigger tower than before.

payload.title: Heavy Side HPG
payload.text: Kabir sat on the see-saw with his much smaller friend at the society playground. Because Kabir was heavier his side stayed pinned down on the ground. The teacher came over and showed them how to lean forward and back to balance. They laughed and the see-saw started moving up and down.
payload.problem: Kabir's side of the see-saw was too heavy

payload.title: Hidden Long
payload.text: Anaya hid behind the big slide at the playground and stayed very still during hide and seek. Her friends searched for a long time and could not find her. Anaya finally came out laughing when she heard them calling her name. They told her she had won the round.
payload.problem: Anaya stayed hidden for a long time

payload.title: Tag Rule
payload.text: Aditya was playing tag at the school playground when an argument started. His friend said the tag did not count. Aditya thought it had counted. Both calmed down and Aditya offered to start the round again. His friend smiled and they made a new rule together.
payload.problem: Aditya solved a tag argument fairly

payload.title: Hopscotch Champ
payload.text: Meera and Tara played hopscotch at the playground after school. Meera hopped on every square without touching the lines and finished the round perfectly. Tara clapped for her and said she wanted to try too. They took turns until the sun went down.

payload.title: Sand Trip
payload.text: Ishaan was running on the sand at the playground when he tripped over a hidden stone. He scraped his knee and felt a small sting. The teacher washed the cut with water and gave him a small bandage. After a short rest Ishaan was back to playing again.
payload.problem: Ishaan tripped and scraped his knee

payload.title: Stuck High
payload.text: Sara climbed a small tree at the playground to see how high she could go. She got stuck on a thin branch and could not climb down. Her friend ran to call the teacher. The teacher came with a stool and gently helped Sara step down to the ground.
payload.problem: Sara got stuck on a tree branch

payload.title: Muddy Slip
payload.text: Arjun ran across the village ground after a heavy rain. He slipped on the wet mud and fell flat on his back. His clothes got dirty but he laughed at himself. His friends helped him up and they all played football carefully after that.
payload.problem: Arjun slipped in the wet mud

payload.title: Lonely Wait
payload.text: Ravi reached the village ground but his friends had not come yet. He kicked a small stone around for some time. Slowly his friends arrived one by one with their bats and ball. They quickly chose teams and played a short cricket match before evening.
payload.problem: Ravi waited alone for his friends

payload.title: Wet Slide HPG
payload.text: Tara reached the playground and saw that the slide was wet from the morning rain. Small kids might have slipped on it. Tara grabbed a clean cloth from her bag and wiped the slide top to bottom. Then she let the smaller kids go down first.
payload.problem: The slide was wet and unsafe

payload.title: Brother Push
payload.text: Karan was at the society playground with his small brother. His brother wanted to swing but could not push himself. Karan stood behind and pushed gently each time. His brother giggled and asked for one more push every single time.
payload.problem: Karan pushed the swing for his brother

payload.title: Sad Friend HPG
payload.text: Riya noticed Sneha sitting alone on the playground bench and looking sad. She walked over and asked her what was wrong. Sneha said no one wanted to play hopscotch with her. Riya smiled and said she would love to play, and they played until the sun was low.
payload.problem: Riya cheered up a sad friend

payload.title: Sky Catch
payload.text: Veer was fielding deep at the school playground during a cricket match. The batter hit the ball very high. Veer kept his eye on the ball, ran back and caught it cleanly with both hands. His teammates rushed over to give him high fives.
payload.problem: Veer caught a high ball cleanly

payload.title: Hot Rest
payload.text: Ananya was running around the playground in the hot afternoon sun. After a while she started feeling dizzy and her face turned red. Her friend told her to sit under a tree. Ananya drank water from her bottle, rested for ten minutes and slowly felt better.
payload.problem: Ananya felt dizzy in the heat

payload.title: Brave Jump HPG
payload.text: Sneha stood at the top of the slide at the playground feeling scared to jump off the side ledge. Her friend was waiting at the bottom and said she could do it. Sneha took a deep breath and counted to three. She jumped down safely and felt very proud.
payload.problem: Sneha bravely jumped from the slide

payload.title: Let Kid Go
payload.text: Anjali was waiting in line for the slide at the playground. A small kid joined the line behind her and looked very excited. Anjali smiled and stepped aside to let the small kid slide first. The small kid's mother thanked Anjali for being kind.
payload.problem: Anjali let a smaller kid go first

payload.title: Bee Calm
payload.text: Vikram was sitting on the swing at the playground when a bee began circling near his head. He froze and stayed completely still as his friend had told him before. The bee soon lost interest and flew away. Vikram got off the swing carefully and waved a thank-you to his friend.
payload.problem: Vikram stayed calm with a bee near him

payload.title: Sunny Picture
payload.text: Sneha sat in the art room and started painting a big yellow sun, a small bird and a tall green tree. She used three different brushes and was very careful with the edges. The teacher came over and said it looked very pretty. Sneha was proud and decided to take it home.

payload.title: Forgot Box HAR
payload.text: Aarav forgot his pencil box at home and had no pencil for the art class in the art room. He felt worried at first. Then he asked his friend Karan, who had brought two pencils. Karan shared one with Aarav and Aarav promised to bring an extra for Karan next time.

payload.title: Mother's Garden
payload.text: Priya sat down at home and drew a small garden full of bright flowers and a big yellow sun. She used five crayons of different colours. When she finished, she ran to her mother and showed her. Her mother smiled and stuck the drawing on the fridge.
payload.problem: Priya drew a garden for her mother

payload.title: Soggy Paper
payload.text: Rohan was painting at home with water colours and forgot to dip his brush only lightly. He used too much water and his paper became soft and started tearing in the middle. Rohan felt upset but his sister told him to start fresh. He took a new sheet and used less water this time.
payload.problem: Rohan used too much water and tore his paper

payload.title: Wrong Fold
payload.text: Diya was folding a paper boat in the art room with great care. She made one wrong fold and the boat ended up looking like a crooked hat. She showed it to her brother who laughed gently. He showed her the right fold and they made a perfect boat together.
payload.problem: Diya made a wrong fold on her boat

payload.title: Sticky Spill
payload.text: Kabir was making a paper craft in the art room when his elbow knocked over the open glue bottle. A sticky pool spread across the table. Kabir grabbed tissues and started cleaning at once. He said sorry to the teacher who was happy that he had cleaned up by himself.
payload.problem: Kabir spilled glue on the table

payload.title: Last Brush Share
payload.text: Anaya had only one red brush left in the art room when Sneha came over needing red paint too. Anaya thought for a moment, then washed her brush, gave it to Sneha and used a smaller spare brush herself. Sneha thanked her with a big smile and they both finished their paintings happily.

payload.title: Bright Rainbow HAR
payload.text: Aditya sat at home and drew a bright rainbow with seven colours in order. He used crayons and pressed each colour with care. He felt very happy when he finished. He stuck the picture on his bedroom wall right above his bed.

payload.title: Sunny Sky
payload.text: Meera painted a yellow sun with three small clouds in the art room. She mixed her colours slowly so the sky did not turn muddy. The teacher walked by and said her sky looked very real. Meera felt proud and started painting a small bird in one corner.

payload.title: Bubble Fish
payload.text: Ishaan drew a blue fish inside a big water bowl in the art room. He added many small bubbles around the fish. His friend leaned over and said the bubbles looked very cute. Ishaan added one more fish so the first one would not feel lonely.
payload.problem: Ishaan drew a fish with bubbles

payload.title: Kite Tail HAR
payload.text: Arjun made a paper kite at home for his cousin. The tail kept coming off because he was using only a tiny bit of tape. His sister came in and showed him how to use a longer piece of tape on both sides. Arjun fixed the tail and the kite was finally ready.
payload.problem: The kite tail kept falling off

payload.title: Star Sticker
payload.text: Sara drew her house in the art room with her family standing outside the front door. She added her dog, a small tree and a sun in the corner. The teacher looked at the picture and gave her a shiny star sticker. Sara stuck the star right on top of the sun.

payload.title: Mud Drawing HAR
payload.text: Ravi sat down in the village ground and drew a tall tree on the soft mud with a small stick. His friends came over to see what he was doing. They picked up their own sticks and drew their own trees next to his. Soon the whole patch was a tiny mud forest.
payload.problem: Ravi drew a tree on the mud

payload.title: Make Green
payload.text: Tara walked through the art room and saw Sneha struggling to mix yellow and blue paint to get green. Tara sat next to her and showed her how to mix slowly with small amounts. Soon Sneha had a nice bright green colour. She thanked Tara with a big smile and finished her painting.
payload.problem: Tara helped her friend mix green paint

payload.title: Lost Red
payload.text: Karan was drawing a big red fire truck at home but his red crayon was missing. He searched in his pencil box and on the floor. Finally he found it tucked under the table near the leg. He picked it up and finished his fire truck.
payload.problem: Karan could not find his red crayon

payload.title: Sparrow Branch
payload.text: Riya sat at home and drew a small bird sitting on a thin branch. She coloured the bird grey and the branch brown. Her grandmother came in and said it looked like a real sparrow she had seen in the garden. Riya was happy and put the picture in her drawing folder.

payload.title: Fast Car
payload.text: Veer drew a fast red car with big black wheels in the art room. He added a small driver inside the car wearing a helmet. The teacher walked by and asked him to share his drawing with the class. Veer stood up and showed it proudly to everyone.
payload.problem: Veer drew a fast car and shared it

payload.title: Pretty Wings HAR
payload.text: Ananya painted a butterfly with pink wings and tiny dots on the wings in the art room. She added a small flower beside the butterfly so it would have something to drink from. The teacher liked it so much that she pinned it on the class board for all the kids to see.

payload.title: Watering Girl
payload.text: Anjali drew a small garden at home with many pink and yellow flowers. In the middle she drew a small girl holding a water can. Her mother came in and said the girl in the picture looked just like her. Anjali laughed and said it was meant to be her.
payload.problem: Anjali drew herself in her garden picture

payload.title: Friendly Elephant
payload.text: Vikram drew a big elephant with white tusks and grey skin in the art room. Next to the elephant he drew a small boy holding a flower. His friend looked over and said the elephant looked very friendly. Vikram added a small smile on the elephant's face.

payload.title: Group Song HMU
payload.text: Sneha sang a school song with her whole class in the music class. They all kept the same beat and ended together perfectly. The teacher smiled and said the group sounded very nice. Sneha was very happy that she had been part of a group that worked together so well.
payload.problem: Sneha sang in a tight group song

payload.title: New Tune HMU
payload.text: Aarav learned a new tune on the keyboard at home over the weekend. He played it slowly first to get all the notes right. Then he tried it a little faster. His father came into the room, listened to him play and said it sounded very nice.
payload.problem: Aarav learned a new keyboard tune

payload.title: Stuck Key HMU
payload.text: Priya was playing the harmonium in the music class when one key suddenly got stuck and would not come back up. She told the teacher about it right away. The teacher carefully lifted the key and fixed it. Priya then played her song from the start without any problem.

payload.title: Mic Line
payload.text: Rohan stood on the stage during morning assembly and sang one line of the national song into the mic. The whole school listened in silence. After the song ended his class clapped for a long time. The principal walked over and patted him on the shoulder.
payload.problem: Rohan sang a line on the mic

payload.title: First Note HMU
payload.text: Diya had been trying to blow a clear note on her flute at home for many days. On Sunday morning she finally got it right and the note rang out softly. She ran to her grandmother and played it again. Her grandmother clapped loudly and asked her to play one more time.
payload.problem: Diya played her first clear flute note

payload.title: Drum Beat HMU
payload.text: Kabir was on the drum in the music class while his friends sang the school song. He kept a steady beat right through the song without a single mistake. The teacher said the beat had been perfect from start to end. Kabir felt very proud and a little tired.
payload.problem: Kabir kept a steady drum beat

payload.title: Duo Picked
payload.text: Anaya and Riya sang together in the music class. Their voices matched well and blended into one. The teacher liked it so much that she picked both of them to sing for the school day. Both girls felt very happy and ran to tell their parents.
payload.problem: Anaya was picked to sing for school day

payload.title: Wrong Note Fix
payload.text: Aditya sang a wrong note in the music class and felt shy. His friends did not laugh at him. Instead one of them hummed the correct note so Aditya could match it. Aditya found the right note, said thank you and finished the song with the class.

payload.title: Folk Trio
payload.text: Meera sang an old village folk song in the village ground with her cousin one evening. Her grandmother heard the song and came out to join them. The three of them sang together until the sun went down. The neighbours clapped from their windows.
payload.problem: Meera sang a folk song with her family

payload.title: Broken String
payload.text: Ishaan was playing his toy guitar at home when one of the strings suddenly snapped. He felt sad and went to his brother. His brother smiled, found a new string and tied it carefully. Soon the guitar was ready and they made small tunes together for the rest of the afternoon.
payload.problem: A string broke on Ishaan's guitar

payload.title: Soft Humming HMU
payload.text: Arjun hummed a school song softly at home while drawing pictures in his book. His little sister came in, listened for a moment and said she liked the tune very much. Arjun smiled and sang it a little louder for her. They both ended up humming together.
payload.problem: Arjun hummed a song for his sister

payload.title: Clap Speed
payload.text: Sara clapped to the beat with her friends in the music class. The teacher turned it into a small game by making the beat faster and faster. Sara stayed with the beat the longest and won the round. Her friends clapped for her at the end.

payload.title: Grandfather Beat
payload.text: Ravi sat in the village ground with his grandfather and tapped on a small village drum. His grandfather showed him a simple beat and clapped along to keep time. Ravi learned the beat quickly and joined in. They played together until the rest of the children gathered around.
payload.problem: Ravi learned a drum beat from his grandfather

payload.title: Big Stage HMU
payload.text: Tara sang on the big school stage in front of all the parents and teachers. Her hands were shaking but her voice was steady all the way through. The audience clapped for a long time when she finished. Her teacher said it was one of the best songs of the evening.
payload.problem: Tara sang on the big stage

payload.title: Forgot Words HMU
payload.text: Karan was singing his song on the school stage when his mind suddenly went blank. He stopped and looked nervous. His friend from the side whispered the next line for him. Karan smiled, picked up the words and finished the song to a big round of applause.

payload.title: Soft Voice
payload.text: Riya sang a sweet song in the music class with a soft and calm voice. The teacher said her singing sounded like a small stream. The other kids clapped quietly when she finished. Riya felt very happy and a little shy.
payload.problem: Riya sang with a soft sweet voice

payload.title: Home Parade
payload.text: Veer blew a toy trumpet at home and his sister giggled every single time. He tried to make a simple tune by changing his breath. They started a small parade around the room together. Their mother came in and joined them by clapping along to the beat.
payload.problem: Veer played trumpet for a home parade

payload.title: Steady Through
payload.text: Ananya kept the same beat through the whole song in the music class. She did not lose it even once. The teacher told the class that keeping the beat is the most important skill in music. Ananya felt proud and gave the class a small smile.
payload.problem: Ananya kept the beat through the song

payload.title: Quiet Help
payload.text: Anjali noticed that Sneha was singing the wrong note in the music class. Without making a fuss she quietly hummed the correct note next to her. Sneha caught the right note and the song sounded balanced again. The teacher smiled because she had seen everything.
payload.problem: Anjali helped a friend get the note right

payload.title: Too Loud HMU
payload.text: Vikram was singing so loudly in the music class that the other voices got drowned. The teacher gently asked him to sing softer so everyone could be heard. Vikram lowered his voice and listened carefully to the rest of the group. The song then sounded balanced and the class clapped.

payload.title: Society Six HSP
payload.text: Aarav was batting in the society lane match on a Sunday afternoon. He hit a big six right over the watchman's small room near the gate. His teammates ran out cheering to find the ball and bring it back. The watchman smiled and rolled the ball back to the lane.
payload.problem: Aarav hit a big six over the watchman's room

payload.title: First Goal HSP
payload.text: Priya was playing football at the school sports field during a friendly match. She got the ball near the goal and kicked it past the keeper. The ball rolled into the net for her very first goal. Her team lifted her up and cheered for a long time.

payload.title: Long Rally HSP
payload.text: Rohan and his sister played a very long badminton rally at home. The shuttle went back and forth many times without touching the floor. Finally Rohan missed a soft drop and the rally ended. They both laughed and started counting hits for the next round.
payload.problem: Rohan played a very long rally

payload.title: Kabaddi Catch HSP
payload.text: Diya was defending in a kabaddi match at the sports field. The raider came in confidently and tried to touch many players. Diya stayed calm, watched her chance and caught him by the leg. Her team won the point and went on to win the match.
payload.problem: Diya caught the raider and won the match

payload.title: Race Win
payload.text: Kabir lined up for the short race on sports day at the school field. He focused only on the finish line and ran with all his strength. He came first by a few steps. The teacher pinned a small medal on his shirt and his class clapped loudly.
payload.problem: Kabir came first in the race

payload.title: Relay Trophy
payload.text: Anaya was the last runner in the relay race at the school sports field. She took the baton, ran fast and crossed the finish line first. Her team got a small trophy at the end of the day. She showed it proudly to her mother that evening at home.
payload.problem: Anaya helped her team win the relay

payload.title: One Run Loss
payload.text: Aditya's cricket team needed just two runs to win at the school field. He played a careful shot but got only one run before the last ball. His team lost by one run. He felt very sad but his coach told him he had played well and to try again next time.
payload.problem: Aditya's team lost by one run

payload.title: Twisted Foot HSP
payload.text: Meera was running fast in a match at the sports field when she twisted her foot on a small stone. She sat down on the grass holding her ankle. Her friend ran across the field to call the teacher. The teacher gave her ice for the swelling and asked her to rest.

payload.title: Help Teammate
payload.text: Ishaan was chasing the football at the sports field during a school match. He saw his teammate fall down near the goal. Instead of running for the ball Ishaan stopped and helped his friend stand up first. The coach told him later that good play also means caring for teammates.
payload.problem: Ishaan stopped to help a fallen teammate

payload.title: Caught Out
payload.text: Arjun was playing cricket in the village field with a wooden bat his grandfather had made. He hit a straight shot back at the bowler. The bowler caught it on the way and Arjun was out. He laughed and gave the bat to the next batter.
payload.problem: Arjun got caught out by the bowler

payload.title: Big Hit HSP
payload.text: Ravi was batting in the village field on a bright morning. He hit a long shot into the field for runs. He ran back and forth four times while his team cheered from the side. The other team finally got the ball and threw it back.
payload.problem: Ravi ran four runs after a long hit

payload.title: Keeper Save HSP
payload.text: Sara was the goalkeeper at the school sports field in a tough match. The other team kicked a hard ball at the goal. Sara dived to her left and just managed to push the ball away. Her team cheered and patted her on the back at the next break.

payload.title: Last but Brave
payload.text: Tara ran the race at the school sports field but came last. She felt sad and tears welled up. Her friend walked up and told her that trying hard was the most important thing. Tara smiled and said she would practise more before the next sports day.
payload.problem: Tara came last but kept her spirit

payload.title: Clean Bowled HSP
payload.text: Karan was batting in the society lane match on a Sunday morning. The bowler bowled a fast ball that beat his bat and hit the wickets. Karan was clean bowled. He walked back sadly but waved to the next batter and cheered him on.

payload.title: Net Drop HSP
payload.text: Riya was playing badminton at the sports field with her doubles partner. She tried a hard smash but hit the shuttle into the net instead. They lost the point. Next time she tried a slow lift to the back of the court and won the rally.
payload.problem: Riya hit the shuttle into the net

payload.title: Match Save
payload.text: Veer was the goalkeeper at the sports field during the school final. With one minute left the other team took a hard kick at the goal. Veer jumped and pushed the ball over the bar with his fingertips. The whistle blew and his team won the match.

payload.title: Photo Cup
payload.text: Ananya's team won the small cup at the school sports day after a close final. She was asked to hold the cup for the team photo. Her parents clapped from the side and were very proud. She held the cup all the way home to show her grandmother.

payload.title: Long Race HSP
payload.text: Sneha lined up for the long race at the school sports field. She was tired by the second round and her legs felt heavy. She kept going because she wanted to finish. When she crossed the line her coach gave her a big smile and a bottle of water.

payload.title: Water Share
payload.text: Anjali noticed that her teammate looked very tired during the break at the sports field. She walked over and offered her own water bottle. Her teammate took a long drink, smiled and said thank you. After the break both of them played even better in the second half.
payload.problem: Anjali shared water with a tired teammate

payload.title: Lost Ball HSP
payload.text: Vikram was batting in the society lane match on a Sunday afternoon. He hit the ball so hard that it flew straight over the boundary wall and disappeared from sight. The match had to pause for many minutes. Vikram and his friends searched in the lane next door until they found another ball.
payload.problem: Vikram hit the ball over the wall and lost it

payload.title: Clever Fox
payload.text: Aarav read a short story about a clever fox in the school library after class. The fox in the story tricked a crow into dropping a piece of cheese. Aarav liked the trick part the most. He told the librarian he wanted to read the next story by the same writer.

payload.title: Quiet Please HLB
payload.text: Priya was reading a new book in the school library when her friend started talking loudly. She put a finger to her lips and gently asked him to lower his voice. Her friend said sorry and started whispering instead. The librarian smiled at Priya from her desk.
payload.problem: Priya asked her friend to be quiet

payload.title: Brave Boy
payload.text: Rohan picked a new comic book about a brave boy who saved a small village in the school library. He sat in a corner near the window and finished the book in one sitting. When he returned it he asked the librarian if there was a next part. She said the next part would arrive soon.
payload.problem: Rohan finished a comic in one sitting

payload.title: Late Return HLB
payload.text: Diya returned a story book a day late to the school librarian on Monday morning. She felt sorry and said it had been raining heavily on Sunday. The librarian said it was fine this time but reminded her that returning books on time helps other kids too. Diya promised to plan ahead.
payload.problem: Diya returned a book a day late

payload.title: Honest Tear
payload.text: Kabir was turning a page in the school library when the corner suddenly tore by mistake. He felt sad for a moment. Then he walked straight to the librarian and showed her what had happened. The librarian thanked him for telling the truth and taped the page back together.
payload.problem: Kabir tore a page and owned up to it

payload.title: Animal Shelf
payload.text: Anaya was reading a story in the school library when a small kid walked up and asked her for help. He wanted a book about lions. Anaya took him to the animal section and pointed out a few good books on the lower shelf. The small kid said a big thank you.
payload.problem: Anaya helped a small kid find a lion book

payload.title: Train Pictures
payload.text: Aditya read a picture book about colourful trains in the school library after lunch. He looked at every picture twice and read the captions carefully. He told his friend that he wanted to become a train driver one day. His friend laughed and said he wanted to become a pilot instead.
payload.problem: Aditya read a picture book about trains

payload.title: Top Shelf HLB
payload.text: Meera wanted a book that was on the top shelf in the school library but she could not reach it. She tried to stretch up but it was still too high. She walked over to the librarian and asked for help. The librarian smiled, brought a small stool and took the book down for her.
payload.problem: Meera could not reach the top shelf

payload.title: Bag Find
payload.text: Ishaan was sure he had lost his library book and started looking everywhere in the school library. The librarian saw him searching and gently suggested he check his school bag carefully. Ishaan looked again and found the book at the very bottom of his bag. He laughed and said sorry for the worry.
payload.problem: Ishaan thought he had lost his book

payload.title: Van Story HLB
payload.text: Arjun climbed into the village library van when it stopped near his house. He picked a story book about a clever boy and a king. He sat on the small bench inside the van and read happily for nearly an hour. He borrowed the book to finish at home.
payload.problem: Arjun read a king story in the van

payload.title: Pretty Princess
payload.text: Sara walked through the school library and saw a book with a pretty blue cover on a low shelf. She picked it up and started reading from the first page. The story was about a princess who built her own kite. Sara borrowed the book to finish it at home that evening.

payload.title: Van Borrow
payload.text: Ravi waited near the village square for the library van to arrive on Thursday. When it finally came he climbed in and borrowed a small story book about a farmer's clever son. He went home and read it under the neem tree in his yard until the sun set.
payload.problem: Ravi borrowed a story from the van

payload.title: Read Aloud HLB
payload.text: Tara was sitting in the school library next to her friend who loved listening to stories. Tara read aloud softly so they did not disturb the others. They shared one book and turned the pages together. The librarian smiled when she saw the two friends sharing so nicely.
payload.problem: Tara read aloud softly to a friend

payload.title: Five Books HLB
payload.text: Karan picked five different books from the shelves in the school library. He carried them carefully to a table near the window. He read a little of each book to decide which one to take home. In the end he picked two and put the other three back on the right shelves.
payload.problem: Karan picked five books to look at

payload.title: Words List
payload.text: Riya was reading a story in the school library but many words in it were new to her. She read slowly and wrote down three new words in her little notebook. She planned to ask her teacher about them the next day. The librarian said that was a very smart way to read.
payload.problem: Riya was learning new words from a story

Arjun enjoyed his simple meal slowly and peacefully, listening to the birds singing in the tree.

payload.title: Crispy Golden Dosa
payload.text: Tara woke up early one morning and walked sleepily into the kitchen at home, where a lovely smell was floating in the air. Grandmother was busy making crispy golden dosa on the hot black pan, flipping each one with a flat spoon. Tara stood near the stove, watching closely as each dosa turned a beautiful brown colour. She waited patiently, her mouth watering with hunger. As soon as the dosas were ready, she ate two of them with fresh coconut chutney, and she felt full and very happy.

payload.title: When the Food Fell
payload.text: At school during lunch time, Karan was carefully carrying his plate full of food back to his usual seat in the corner. He was thinking about how tasty his lunch looked and did not watch where he was stepping. Suddenly he tripped over a friend's bag that had been left on the floor, and his entire plate of food spilled with a loud clatter. Karan felt sad and a little embarrassed in front of everyone. But a kind friend quickly shared his own lunch so that Karan could still eat.
payload.problem: Karan's food fell on the floor

payload.title: A Sweet Surprise
payload.text: Riya felt very hungry during the lunch break at school and could hardly wait to open her tiffin box. When she finally lifted the lid, she found warm rice with tasty curry waiting for her. But that was not all. Tucked neatly into one corner of the box was a small, delicious sweet. Riya's face lit up with a bright smile, because she realised that Mother had quietly packed the sweet as a special little surprise just for her, to make her lunch even more wonderful that day.

payload.title: Cleaning His Own Plate
payload.text: Veer came home extremely hungry after a long and tiring day at school. Mother had cooked rice and a tasty curry, which she served to him on a shiny steel plate. Veer sat down at the table and ate hungrily, making sure not to leave even a single grain of rice behind. When he had finished his meal, he did something thoughtful. He carried his empty plate to the kitchen, washed it himself under the tap, and then helped Mother wipe the table clean for the next meal.

payload.title: The Tiffin Left Behind
payload.text: Ananya was in a great hurry that morning, trying her best to catch the school van on time. In all the rush, she forgot her tiffin box sitting on the kitchen table at home. When the lunch break finally arrived at school, she opened her bag and realised, to her dismay, that she had no food at all. She felt very hungry and a little worried. Then a kind friend noticed and shared her own lunch, and Ananya thanked her warmly with a big and grateful smile.

payload.title: Bread with Sweet Jam
payload.text: Anjali began to feel hungry during her lunch break, so she walked over to the school canteen together with a few of her friends. After looking at the choices, she bought two soft slices of bread that were spread thickly with sweet red jam. She carried her plate to a quiet table that stood near a big window. There she ate her bread slowly, taking small bites, while she happily watched the other children running and playing in the busy yard outside the canteen window.

payload.title: A Bunch of Sweet Grapes
payload.text: At the lunch break in school, Sneha opened a small plastic box that was full of sweet, juicy green grapes. As she began to eat, the friend sitting right beside her kept glancing at the grapes with hungry, longing eyes. Sneha noticed this at once and felt that she should share. With a warm smile, she pulled off a nice bunch of grapes and gave them to her friend. The two girls then sat together, eating the cool, juicy grapes one by one and sharing many happy stories.
payload.problem: Sneha wanted to share her grapes

payload.title: Asking for More
payload.text: Aarav came home from school feeling extremely hungry after a long and tiring day full of classes and games. Mother served him a big plate of warm rice and dal, which smelled absolutely wonderful and made his stomach growl. Aarav started eating quickly because the food was so tasty and he was so hungry. He finished everything on his plate in no time at all. But he was still a little hungry, so he politely asked Mother for one more helping, and she happily served him some more.

payload.title: Finding the Window Seat
payload.text: Ravi climbed onto the school bus early in the morning, hoping very much to get a seat near the window so he could watch the road. The seats at the front were already filled with other excited children, so Ravi began to walk slowly towards the back of the bus. As he searched, he spotted one empty seat right beside a window. He hurried over and sat down happily. As the bus started to roll along the road, Ravi watched the trees, shops, and people move quickly past his window.

payload.title: The Bus That Was Late
payload.text: Priya reached the bus stop quite early in the morning and stood there patiently, waiting for her school bus to arrive. Minutes passed by slowly, and still the bus did not come. She looked up and down the road again and again, but there was no sign of it. Priya began to worry that she would be late for school and miss her first class. Just as her worry grew, the familiar bus finally came around the corner. Feeling very relieved, Priya climbed on board quickly and found a seat.

payload.title: The Cheerful Van Driver
payload.text: Rohan walked out of his house in the morning and climbed into the school van that was waiting just outside the gate. The kind van driver waved at him and called out a cheerful good morning to all the children sitting inside. Rohan smiled back and made his way to his usual seat near the middle. He put his heavy school bag down on the floor and greeted his friends, who were already chatting away.

payload.title: Buying the Ticket
payload.text: Anaya rode the busy city bus together with Mother on their way to visit the crowded market. As the bus moved along, the conductor came walking down the aisle, collecting fares from all the passengers. When he reached their seats, Anaya carefully handed him the exact money for one ticket. The conductor tore off a small paper ticket and gave it to her, along with a few coins of change.

payload.title: Hunting for a Seat
payload.text: Kabir got onto the city bus, only to find that it was very crowded, with many people standing in the aisle and holding the bars. He looked around near the front but could not see a single empty seat anywhere. So he began to make his way slowly towards the back of the bus, carefully holding onto the bars so he would not lose his balance when the bus turned. At last, near the very back, he spotted one empty seat in the corner.
payload.problem: Kabir could not find a seat

payload.title: Offering Her Seat
payload.text: Diya was sitting comfortably on the bus, enjoying the ride, when it stopped to let more passengers climb aboard. Among them was an old lady who walked slowly with a stick. By that time, every seat on the bus was already taken, and there was no place for the lady to sit. Diya noticed that the old lady looked tired and was finding it very hard to stand while the bus moved.
payload.problem: An old lady had no seat

payload.title: Past His Stop
payload.text: Aditya was sitting on the bus, gazing out of the window at the many shops and the crowds of people on the street. He was so busy watching everything around him that he completely forgot to pay attention to where the bus was going. Before he knew it, the bus had already driven straight past his own stop. By the time Aditya realised his mistake, his stop was far behind him.

payload.title: The Long Train Journey
payload.text: Meera went on a long and exciting train journey with Mother to visit her aunt who lived in another town. She was thrilled to get the window seat, which was her favourite spot on any train. As the train began to move and pick up speed, Meera watched the world rush by outside. She saw wide green fields, small winding rivers, and tiny villages with little houses.
payload.problem: Meera was on a train journey

payload.title: His First Metro Ride
payload.text: Vikram held Father's hand very tightly as they stood together on the busy metro platform, surrounded by many people. When the metro train arrived with a loud whoosh of air, they quickly stepped inside before the doors slid shut. Vikram found a place to stand and looked out through the window at the dark tunnel rushing past. The fast metro carried them smoothly underground, and Vikram felt both a little nervous and very excited.

payload.title: The Bumpy Village Ride
payload.text: Ishaan rode the old village bus along a rough and dusty road that wound through the fields. The road was full of holes, stones, and uneven patches, so the bus shook, rattled, and bounced as it moved slowly along. Every time the bus rolled over a big bump, all the passengers jumped a little in their seats and held on tightly. Ishaan gripped the edge of his seat with both hands so that he would not fall.

payload.title: Watching the Busy City
payload.text: Sara sat down by the window on the bus that took her to school every morning. This was her very favourite seat, because from there she could see everything that happened outside. As the bus moved along the road, she watched the busy streets full of cars, the colourful shops with their bright signs, and the many people walking quickly to their work. The journey was always full of interesting sights for her.

payload.title: Racing to the Bus Stop
payload.text: Arjun woke up much later than usual one morning and realised that he had very little time to get ready for school. He hurried through everything, scared that he would miss his bus and be late for his first class. He grabbed his school bag, slipped on his shoes, and dashed out of the house. Then he ran as fast as his legs could carry him all the way to the bus stop.
payload.problem: Arjun was almost late for the bus

payload.title: Keeping the Bag Safe
payload.text: Tara got onto a very crowded bus while carrying her school bag, which was heavy with books and notebooks. There was hardly any space to stand, and people kept pushing past her as the bus filled up. Tara was worried that something might fall out of her bag or that she might lose it in the crowd. So she held the bag tightly on her lap with both arms wrapped around it.
payload.problem: Tara had to keep her bag safe

payload.title: Paying the Bus Fare
payload.text: Karan got onto the bus and quickly found himself a seat near the door, where he settled down for the ride. After a little while, the conductor began to walk through the bus, collecting the fare from all the passengers one by one. When the conductor reached Karan, the boy took out the coins that his mother had given him that morning and handed them over carefully. The conductor counted the money, nodded, and gave him a small paper ticket in return.
payload.problem: Karan had to pay the fare

payload.title: Waiting for the School Van
payload.text: Riya stood at the bus stop early in the morning, waiting eagerly for her school van to come and pick her up. She kept looking down the long road again and again, hoping to catch a glimpse of the familiar yellow van. But minute after minute went by, and there was still no sign of it. The van seemed to be running a little late that day, and Riya began to feel worried that she might be late for school.
payload.problem: Riya was waiting for the van

payload.title: No Place to Sit
payload.text: Veer got onto the city bus during the busy evening hour, when many people were returning home from work. He looked around hopefully, but every single seat on the bus was already taken by other tired passengers. Since there was nowhere at all for him to sit down, Veer made his way to a spot near the door. He held onto the metal bar tightly with both of his hands to keep his balance.

payload.title: Waiting at the Station
payload.text: Ananya went to the busy railway station with Father, because they were going to take a train to her grandmother's town for the holidays. They walked onto the crowded platform and stood together, waiting for their train to arrive. While they waited, Ananya watched with wide eyes as many trains pulled in and rolled out, each one full of people and piles of luggage. The huge, bustling station made her feel very excited and a little bit small.
payload.problem: Ananya was waiting for the train

payload.title: Waving Down the Bus
payload.text: Anjali stood at the bus stop and saw her bus coming down the road towards her from a distance. She knew very well that if she did not give a clear signal, the driver might not notice her and could drive straight past without stopping. So she raised her hand high and waved it clearly back and forth, making sure that the driver could see her plainly. The bus slowed down and came to a gentle stop right in front of where she stood.
payload.problem: Anjali wanted the bus to stop

payload.title: First One in the Van
payload.text: Sneha got ready unusually early that morning, so she was the very first child to climb into the school van. She greeted the driver politely and then said a cheerful hello to each of her friends as they came in one by one and took their places. She settled comfortably into her usual seat near the middle of the van and chatted with the others while they waited.

payload.title: Aarav's First City Bus
payload.text: Aarav rode the big city bus for the very first time in his life, sitting close beside Father for comfort. The bus was large and crowded, full of strangers he did not know, and Aarav felt a little nervous and unsure.
