Seeing this, Father gently showed him how to hold onto the bar so that he would not lose his balance when the bus turned a corner. He also pointed out the exact place where they would get down at their stop.
payload.problem: Aarav was nervous on his first bus ride

payload.title: Saving for a Cricket Bat
payload.text: Ravi was given a shiny new coin by Father one quiet evening at home. Many other children would have run straight to the nearby shop to spend it on sweets, but Ravi had a very different plan in mind. Instead of spending the coin, he carefully dropped it into his piggy bank, where it landed with a soft clink. He had a dream of buying a real cricket bat one day.
payload.problem: Ravi wanted to save for a bat

payload.title: The Coin That Rolled Away
payload.text: Priya walked all the way to the shop to buy a new pencil that she needed for her school work. When she reached the counter, she took her only coin out of her pocket to pay the shopkeeper. But just as she held it out, the coin slipped from between her fingers, fell onto the floor, and rolled far away under the wooden shelves. Priya bent down and searched everywhere, looking carefully under each shelf, but she simply could not find it anywhere.

payload.title: A Secret Box of Rupees
payload.text: Rohan had set his heart on buying a small toy car that he had seen and liked very much at the shop. He understood that he could not get it right away and that he would have to save up his money first. So at home, he kept all of his rupees safe inside a small wooden box, which he hid carefully under his bed where no one would find it. Every single week, he added a few more coins to the box.
payload.problem: Rohan wanted to save for a toy

payload.title: The Honest Thing to Do
payload.text: Anaya was walking quietly through her classroom at school one afternoon when she noticed something lying on the floor. It was a crisp ten rupee note, sitting all by itself near a desk. She bent down and picked it up, then looked all around the room to see who might have dropped it, but she could not tell whose money it was. Anaya knew deep down that it would be wrong to keep something that did not belong to her.

payload.title: Paying at the Busy Market
payload.text: Kabir went to the busy, crowded market together with Mother to buy fresh vegetables for the evening dinner. As they moved from stall to stall, he eagerly helped pick out plump red tomatoes and crisp green beans, handing them to the friendly shopkeeper. When all the shopping was done, Kabir carefully counted out the money and paid the exact amount that was due for everything. He felt very grown up and proud of himself.
payload.problem: Kabir had to pay for vegetables

payload.title: Helping Count the Coins
payload.text: One evening at home, Mother sat down with a big, heavy pile of coins that she needed to count carefully before going to the market the next day. Diya saw her and wanted to help, so she sat down beside Mother on the floor right away. To make the counting much easier and faster, Diya cleverly arranged the coins into small neat groups of ten coins each. Then she counted the groups one by one, which made the whole job quick and simple.

payload.title: Counting the Change Carefully
payload.text: Aditya walked to the shop near his house because he needed to buy a new pen for school the next morning. He looked at the pens on display and chose a smooth blue one that he liked the most. He gave the shopkeeper a twenty rupee note to pay for it. The shopkeeper handed him the pen along with some coins as his change. Before leaving the shop, Aditya remembered what Father always told him, and he carefully counted the change in his palm.

payload.title: The Extra Pocket Money
payload.text: Every week, Meera received her pocket money from Father at home, which she always looked forward to with great excitement. This particular week, she was given a little extra amount because she had been so helpful around the house, cleaning her room and watering all the plants without being asked. Meera felt happy and very proud of the extra reward she had earned. Instead of rushing out to spend it all at once on small things, she made a wise choice.

payload.title: Only Two Coins Left
payload.text: Vikram reached deep into his pocket at home one afternoon and discovered, to his surprise, that he had only two coins left to his name. He pulled them out and counted them again very carefully, just to be completely sure of how much money he actually had. With such a small amount, he sat and thought hard about what, if anything, he could possibly buy with it. After thinking it over for a while, he came to a sensible decision.

payload.title: Buying a Packet of Sweets
payload.text: Ishaan had been patiently saving his coins for quite some time, and at last he had collected enough money to buy something nice for himself. Excited, he walked to the shop and gazed at the shelves, which were full of brightly coloured packets of treats. After looking carefully at all the choices, he chose a packet of his very favourite sweets. He counted out his coins and handed the money to the shopkeeper, who gave him the packet. When Ishaan got back home, he did something kind and generous.

payload.title: The Clear Glass Jar
payload.text: Sara had seen a beautiful story book at the shop that she wanted very much, but she did not have nearly enough money to buy it yet. So she made up her mind to save up slowly, little by little, at home. She found a clear glass jar and kept it on the shelf in her room especially for her coins. Each and every day, she dropped one or two coins inside the jar, listening to the cheerful clink they made.
payload.problem: Sara wanted to save for a book

payload.title: Giving Back the Money
payload.text: Arjun found a folded note lying quietly on the wooden bench in his school classroom one morning. He picked it up and looked around, and just then he noticed his friend nearby, searching the floor anxiously and looking very worried and upset. Arjun quickly understood that the money must surely belong to his friend. Without any hesitation at all, he walked over and handed the folded note straight back to him.
payload.problem: Arjun found his friend's lost note

payload.title: The Shiny Hidden Coin
payload.text: Tara was helping to sweep and clean the floor at home one afternoon when something bright and shiny suddenly caught her eye near the table. Curious, she bent down low and peered carefully into the shadows underneath the heavy wooden table. There, hidden in a little patch of dust, she found a small, bright coin that someone must have dropped long ago. Tara reached in, picked it up, and brushed it clean with her fingers.

payload.title: Bananas for the Family
payload.text: Karan went to the busy market one morning to buy bananas for the whole family's breakfast. He walked from stall to stall, looking carefully at the many bunches of fruit on display. After a while, he picked out a lovely bunch of yellow bananas that were just perfectly ripe and ready to eat. He gave the money to the shopkeeper and waited politely for his change to be returned.

payload.title: The Heavy Piggy Bank
payload.text: Riya had been saving her coins faithfully for many weeks at home, dropping them into her piggy bank one by one whenever she got any. Then one fine day, she picked up the piggy bank and noticed that it had become surprisingly heavy in her hands and felt completely full inside. Excited and curious, she asked Mother for help. Together they carefully opened the piggy bank and tipped out all the coins onto the table. Riya counted every coin slowly and carefully.

payload.title: Paying the Exact Amount
payload.text: Veer walked to the shop because he needed to buy a brand new notebook for his school work. He browsed the shelves and picked out a neat notebook with a bright blue cover that he liked. He carried it to the counter, where the shopkeeper told him the small bill amount that he would have to pay. Veer reached into his pocket and took out his coins, then counted them out very carefully on the counter, making sure he paid the exact amount and not a coin less.
payload.problem: Veer had to pay the bill

payload.title: Saving for the Toy Car
payload.text: Ananya saw a shiny new toy car in the window of the shop one day, and she wanted it so badly that she could think of nothing else. But she quickly realised that she did not have nearly enough money to buy it yet. So she decided to save up patiently at home, coin by coin. She kept a small box just for her savings and stopped spending her money on sweets and other little treats.
payload.problem: Ananya wanted to save for a toy car

payload.title: Remembering to Return It
payload.text: The week before, Anjali had borrowed a single coin from her friend so that she could buy herself a small snack during the break. She did not want to be the kind of person who forgets to return what she has borrowed. So that morning, she made sure to bring the coin with her from home. When she got to school, she waited for the break time, then walked over to her friend. She returned the coin and said a polite and warm thank you for the kindness.
payload.problem: Anjali had to return a borrowed coin

payload.title: Buying a Packet of Milk
payload.text: Mother gently asked Sneha if she could go and buy a packet of milk from the small shop just down the lane. Sneha agreed happily and took the money that Mother gave her, holding it tightly in her hand. She walked carefully along the lane until she reached the familiar little shop. There she handed the coins to the shopkeeper and politely asked for one packet of milk. The shopkeeper smiled and gave her the cool packet of milk.

payload.title: Dropping in the First Coin
payload.text: Aarav was given a brand new piggy bank as a special gift at home, and he was absolutely thrilled to receive it. The piggy bank was bright and cheerful, and Aarav could not wait to begin saving his money inside it. He decided that he would start saving right away, that very day. So he searched around and found his very first coin to put inside. Holding it carefully, he slipped the coin into the small slot on top and listened.

payload.title: The Thin Street Dog
payload.text: Ravi was walking slowly near his home one afternoon when he noticed a street dog standing by the gate. The dog looked very thin and hungry, and it watched Ravi closely with big, sad eyes that seemed to be asking for help. Feeling kind and sorry for the poor animal, Ravi hurried inside the house and brought out a handful of biscuits from the kitchen. He placed the biscuits gently on the ground in front of the dog.

payload.title: The Cat in the Corner
payload.text: Priya climbed up to the terrace to help Mother dry the freshly washed clothes in the warm sunshine. As she was hanging up the clothes, she noticed a small cat sitting quietly all by itself in one corner of the terrace. The cat turned its head, looked straight at Priya, and meowed softly, as though it were trying to tell her that it was hungry. Priya felt sorry for the lonely little cat and wanted to help it.
payload.problem: A hungry cat was on the terrace

payload.title: The Quick Banana Thief
payload.text: Rohan was standing near the open balcony at home, carefully peeling a ripe banana that he was looking forward to eating. All of a sudden, without any warning at all, a quick and clever monkey leaped up onto the balcony railing right beside him. Before Rohan even had a chance to react, the cheeky monkey reached out and snatched the banana straight out of his hand. Then it scampered away across the rooftops with its prize.

payload.title: The Cow in the Path
payload.text: Anaya was walking along the narrow village road on her way to visit a friend's house in the next lane. As she came around a gentle bend in the road, she suddenly found a big cow standing right in the middle of the path, completely blocking her way. The cow was chewing slowly and lazily, and it did not seem to be in any hurry to move at all. Anaya knew it was best not to frighten the animal, so she stood and waited very patiently.

payload.title: The Bird at the Glass
payload.text: Kabir was sitting at his desk at home, busy doing his homework, when he suddenly heard a soft thump against the window glass. Startled, he looked up and saw that a little bird had flown straight into the clear glass and had fallen down onto the window sill below. The poor bird seemed dazed and confused, and it was not able to fly away. Kabir felt very worried about it.
payload.problem: A bird had hurt itself on the window

payload.title: The Bright Green Parrot
payload.text: Diya went out into the garden at home one bright morning to water all the plants before the sun became too hot. As she gently sprinkled water over the green leaves with her little can, she happened to look up and noticed something beautiful. A bright green parrot was sitting on a branch of the tree right above her head. The parrot tilted its head to one side and stared down at Diya with its sharp, clever little eyes.

payload.title: The Wobbly Little Calf
payload.text: Aditya went to visit his grandfather in the village during the school holidays, which he always looked forward to very much. One day, while walking near the cattle shed, he saw a baby calf standing carefully on its thin, wobbly legs, looking unsteady. The calf turned and gazed at Aditya with its big, gentle, and curious eyes. Feeling drawn to the sweet little animal, Aditya walked towards it slowly and softly, so as not to scare it.

payload.title: Rice for the Hungry Dog
payload.text: Meera noticed a street dog wandering slowly near her home one afternoon, and she saw at once that it looked very thin and hungry. Her heart filled with pity for the poor, helpless animal. Wanting to help, she went straight into the kitchen and brought out a plate with some leftover rice on it. She carried the plate outside and placed it down gently on the ground in front of the dog. The hungry dog sniffed it eagerly and then ate up all the rice very quickly.

payload.title: The Kitten in the Bushes
payload.text: Vikram was playing happily in the garden at home one afternoon when he suddenly heard a tiny, soft mewing sound coming from somewhere nearby. Curious, he walked closer and looked carefully among the leaves and branches of the bushes. There, hidden away, he found a small kitten crouching and shivering, looking both frightened and very hungry. Vikram wanted to help the little creature but did not want to scare it. So he gently poured some milk into a small bowl and placed it close to the bushes, then stepped back.
payload.problem: A kitten was hiding and hungry

payload.title: The Goat That Jumped
payload.text: Ishaan walked out to the wide open field near his grandfather's village to enjoy the fresh morning air and the peaceful surroundings. As he strolled along, he spotted a brown goat standing near a low wooden fence at the edge of the field. To his great surprise and delight, the goat suddenly leaped right over the fence with the greatest of ease, as if it were the simplest thing in the world. Ishaan laughed out loud and clapped his hands together with joy at the sight.

payload.title: The Busy Little Squirrel
payload.text: Sara was playing happily with her friends in the park one warm afternoon, running and laughing in the sunshine. After a while, she stopped to rest in the cool shade beneath a tall tree. As she sat there catching her breath, she noticed a little squirrel dart quickly up the rough trunk of the tree. The squirrel stopped on a branch above her, sat up on its back legs, and held a small nut tightly between its tiny front paws. Then it began to nibble at the nut busily.

payload.title: A Game of Fetch
payload.text: Arjun went to the park one sunny afternoon and there he met a big, friendly dog wagging its bushy tail near the gate. The dog looked at him cheerfully and seemed to want to play a game. So Arjun found a ball, drew back his arm, and threw it as far as he could across the wide green grass. The eager dog raced after the ball at top speed, caught it neatly in its mouth, and came bounding back to drop it right at Arjun's feet.

payload.title: Water on a Hot Day
payload.text: On a very hot and dry afternoon, Tara was sitting near the window at home when she noticed a small bird perched on the window sill outside. The little bird looked tired, and it was panting in the heat, clearly very thirsty and in need of some water. Tara felt a wave of sympathy for the poor creature suffering in the hot weather.

payload.title: Shutting Out the Monkey
payload.text: Karan was up on the terrace one afternoon, enjoying the open air, when he noticed a monkey sitting on the boundary wall not far away. He watched it for a moment and saw, with growing worry, that the monkey was staring intently at the open window of his house, looking ready to jump straight inside. Karan knew very well that if the monkey got into the house, it could grab food, scatter things about, and even break something.
payload.problem: A monkey might enter the house

payload.title: The Stubborn Cow
payload.text: Riya was on her way to the market with Mother to buy some fresh fruits for the house. As they approached the busy market gate, they came upon a big cow standing completely still right in the middle of the narrow path. The cow chewed lazily and calmly, showing no sign at all that it was going to move any time soon. Riya and Mother waited there patiently for a little while, hoping the cow would wander off on its own.

payload.title: Feeding the Ducks
payload.text: Veer went to visit the village during the holidays and one cool evening he walked down to the pond together with Grandfather. When they reached the water's edge, Veer saw a whole group of ducks swimming about and diving happily under the surface of the pond. He thought they looked wonderful and wished he could feed them. Seeing this, Grandfather kindly gave him a handful of grains to throw.
payload.problem: Veer saw ducks in the pond

payload.title: The Cat on the Chair
payload.text: Ananya came home from school feeling rather tired after a long day, and she headed straight to her room hoping to sit down and rest for a while. But when she opened the door, she found a cat curled up and sleeping peacefully on her favourite soft chair. The cat looked so comfortable, so calm, and so deeply asleep that Ananya simply did not have the heart to disturb it or chase it away.
payload.problem: A cat was sleeping on her chair

payload.title: Building the Little Nest
payload.text: Anjali went up onto the terrace one bright morning and happened to glance towards the quiet corner where she liked to sit. There she saw a small bird flying busily back and forth, again and again, carrying tiny twigs and bits of dry leaves in its little beak. She quickly understood that the clever bird was hard at work building itself a neat little nest in the corner. Anjali was completely fascinated by the sight.
payload.problem: A bird was building a nest

payload.title: The Lonely Lost Puppy
payload.text: Sneha was walking near her school gate one morning when she suddenly heard a soft, sad little whine coming from somewhere close by. She stopped and looked around carefully, and there she discovered a small puppy sitting all by itself, looking lost, frightened, and alone. The poor puppy seemed thirsty and afraid. Feeling very sorry for it, Sneha gently gave the puppy some water to drink from her own water bottle. Then, knowing that the little puppy needed proper care, she went and told the kind watchman all about it.
payload.problem: A puppy was lost and alone

payload.title: The Parrot That Answered Back
payload.text: Aarav was sitting outside in the village one quiet and peaceful afternoon, simply enjoying the calm and the gentle breeze. All of a sudden, he heard a loud, sharp call ring out through the air. Looking up, he saw a bright and colourful parrot perched high up at the very top of a tall tree, calling loudly. Just for fun, Aarav decided to try and copy the funny sound that the parrot was making with his own voice.

payload.title: Building the Tallest Tower
payload.text: Ravi sat down on the floor at home with his big box full of colourful lego blocks spread out all around him. He had made up his mind that today he would build the very tallest tower that he had ever managed to make. Working slowly and with great care, he placed one block carefully on top of another, making sure each one was perfectly straight so that the tower would not lean or fall. Bit by bit, the tower grew higher and higher, rising up before his eyes.
payload.problem: Ravi wanted to build a tall tower

payload.title: The Grand Sand Castle
payload.text: Priya went to the park, where she found a big pile of soft, wet sand sitting near the swings, just perfect for building. She had really wanted to make a grand sand castle, and now she had her chance. Using a small plastic bucket, she carefully shaped the tall walls of the castle, pressing the sand down firmly each time so that it would hold together well and not crumble apart. She worked patiently for a long while until the castle was complete.
payload.problem: Priya wanted to make a sand castle

payload.title: Watching the Builders Work
payload.text: Rohan stood near the building site that was located close to his house, a place he loved to visit. He watched the workers there going about their busy job with great interest. They picked up heavy bricks one at a time and placed them carefully on top of one another, joining each one to the next with thick grey cement. Right before his eyes, a brand new wall was slowly growing taller and taller each and every day.

payload.title: A Sturdy Wall for the Dolls
payload.text: Anaya sat down comfortably on the floor at home with her big box of toy bricks beside her. She had a clear plan in her mind: she wanted to build a strong, sturdy wall that could serve as a little house for her favourite dolls. With great care, she began to stack the bricks one on top of another, paying close attention so that they were balanced properly and would not suddenly topple over and fall. She worked away patiently for quite some time, fixing each brick into place.
payload.problem: Anaya wanted to build a wall

payload.title: Why Mud Houses Stay Cool
payload.text: Kabir went to the village together with his family during the long summer holidays, a trip he always enjoyed. While he was walking around exploring, he came across a small mud house that had a roof made entirely of dry grass. Kabir was very curious and could not understand why anyone would choose to build a whole house out of plain mud. He turned to Grandfather and asked him about it.

payload.title: The Unsafe Cracked Wall
payload.text: Diya was walking across the school playground during the morning break when something suddenly caught her attention. She saw a wall with a big, deep crack running all the way down the middle of it. The broken wall looked weak and very unsafe, almost as if it might crumble and fall down at any moment. Diya understood at once that this could be dangerous for the other children playing nearby. So without delay, she went straight to her class teacher and told her all about the cracked wall.

payload.title: Taking the Lift Up
payload.text: Aditya wanted to go all the way up to the terrace of his tall building so that he could fly his brand new kite in the open air. Rather than climbing up the many long flights of stairs, he decided that it would be much easier to take the lift instead. He stepped inside the lift, pressed the round button for the very top floor, and stood quietly while it carried him upward.
payload.problem: Aditya wanted to reach the terrace

payload.title: The Friendly Watchman's Room
payload.text: Meera was leaving for school one morning when she passed by the small room that stood near the main gate of her building. It was the watchman's room, and inside it she could see a simple wooden chair, a small table, and a fan that whirred slowly in the warm air. The friendly watchman was sitting there as always, keeping a careful eye on everyone who came in and went out through the gate.

payload.title: The Wonderful View from the Top
payload.text: Vikram climbed all the way up to the terrace of his tall building one pleasant evening, eager to look at the world from up high. When he reached the top and looked around, he could see many other tall buildings standing all around him in every direction. He went to the edge and looked down carefully at the road far, far below, where the moving cars and walking people looked as tiny as little toys.

payload.title: A Block House for Toy Cars
payload.text: Ishaan sat down at home with a big box of toy building blocks emptied out all around him on the floor. He had a clever idea in his head: he wanted to make a small house with a door that was wide enough for his little toy cars to drive in and out of easily. He set to work carefully, building up the walls of the house one block at a time, making them neat and strong.
payload.problem: Ishaan wanted to build a house

payload.title: Digging a Sand Tunnel
payload.text: Sara was at the park, where there happened to be a large heap of soft, cool sand piled up near the slide, perfect for digging. She began to dig a deep hole in the sand using both of her hands, scooping out the sand handful by handful. After she had dug for a while, a clever idea came to her, and she started to dig another hole from the opposite side of the heap as well.
payload.problem: Sara wanted to dig a tunnel

payload.title: The Farmer's Field Hut
payload.text: Arjun walked through the wide, open village fields together with Grandfather on a bright and sunny morning. As they strolled along the narrow path between the crops, Arjun noticed a small hut built out of mud and wood standing right at the edge of one of the fields. He wondered who the little hut could belong to and why it was there. Curious, he turned and asked Grandfather about it.

payload.title: Trying Once More
payload.text: Tara was busy building a tall tower with her colourful toy bricks at home one afternoon. She added block after block, and the tower grew steadily taller and taller as she worked. But just as it reached its very highest point, the whole tower suddenly wobbled, leaned over, and came crashing down to the floor with a loud clatter. For a brief moment, Tara felt quite sad and disappointed that all her hard work had collapsed. But she did not give up.

payload.title: The Mighty Yellow Crane
payload.text: Karan stood near the building site one afternoon and tilted his head back to look high up into the sky above him. There he saw a tall, bright yellow crane that was busy lifting a heavy load of bricks all the way up to the very top floor of the new building under construction. He watched in amazement as the great crane swung its long arm slowly and very carefully through the air.
payload.problem: Karan watched a crane lift bricks

payload.title: Counting All the Windows
payload.text: Riya had been watching a brand new house being slowly built near her home over the course of many days, and she found it very interesting. Every single morning, when she looked at it, a little more of the house seemed to have been finished than the day before. One day, out of pure curiosity, she decided that she would count all of the windows on the front of the house.
payload.problem: Riya saw a new house being built

payload.title: The Worker on the Tall Ladder
payload.text: Veer went near the building site together with Father one afternoon, holding his hand as they walked. While they were there, Veer noticed a very tall ladder leaning steeply against the side of the new building. As he stood watching, a worker began to climb up the ladder slowly and steadily, carrying a heavy bucket of white paint in one of his hands. Veer watched the man go higher and higher up the ladder, rung by rung, until he was quite far above the ground.
payload.problem: Veer saw a worker on a tall ladder

payload.title: Mending the Broken Gate
payload.text: Ananya came home from school one afternoon and noticed a big pile of bricks lying near the main gate of her building. A group of workers were busy at the spot, fixing the old gate, which had become broken and would not close properly anymore. Ananya knew very well that she should not go too close to the bricks, the tools, and the wet cement, as it could be dangerous. So she stood at a safe distance and watched the work with curiosity.

payload.title: The Old Grass Roof Hut
payload.text: Anjali visited the village together with Grandmother during the school holidays, a place she did not often get to see. As the two of them walked slowly along a quiet country path, Anjali noticed a small hut with a roof that was made entirely out of dry grass bundled neatly together. She had never seen a house quite like it before, and she liked its plain and simple look very much indeed. Full of curiosity, she turned to Grandmother and asked her many questions about the unusual little hut.
payload.problem: Anjali saw a grass roof hut

payload.title: Waiting for the Lift to Come
payload.text: Sneha came home feeling very tired after a long and busy day at school. The thought of climbing all the way up the many flights of stairs to reach her flat made her feel even more tired. So she decided to take the lift up instead. She pressed the button to call the lift and then stood quietly in front of the closed doors, waiting. As she waited, she watched the lighted floor numbers above the door slowly counting down one after another, getting closer and closer to her floor.

payload.title: The Complete Lego House
payload.text: Aarav spent the entire evening at home happily playing with his big set of colourful lego blocks. He had set himself an exciting goal for the day: he wanted to build a complete house, not just a simple wall or a plain tower like before. Working with great care and patience, he first built the four sturdy walls of the house. Then he added a sloping roof on top, a front door for going in and out, and two small windows to let in the light.
payload.problem: Aarav wanted to build a complete house

payload.title: Granny's Winter Story
payload.text: On a cool winter night, Anjali sat with Granny on the warm terrace under a soft blanket and a small lamp. Granny told a long story about a brave village girl who saved her small puppy from a rainy night and walked back to her home through a wet field. Anjali listened with wide eyes till the last line.

payload.title: Ravi at the Library
payload.text: Ravi sat in the school library during the quiet reading hour after lunch. He picked a small story book from the kids shelf and read each page with full care till the end of the period. The room was so quiet that he could hear the slow ceiling fan and the soft sound of pages turning at the next table near the window.
payload.problem: He wanted to read a story

payload.title: Sneha's Bedtime Tale
payload.text: Mother sat near Sneha in the warm bedroom and read a kind tale about a lost puppy who found a new home in a small village. Sneha smiled, hugged her favourite cloth doll, and closed her eyes slowly as the story moved to the happy end. Mother kissed her forehead and switched off the lamp before she left the room slowly.

payload.title: Aarav's Funny Book
payload.text: Aarav read a funny tale in his small room after lunch on a quiet afternoon. He laughed so much that his big brother came in from the next room to ask what was so very funny. They both sat together on the soft bed and read the same tale once again, line by line, and they both laughed loudly at every silly part of the story.

payload.title: Father and Diya's Tale
payload.text: Father sat near Diya before bedtime and told her a soft tale about a kind, smiling star who helped lost children find their way back to their homes in the cold dark night. Diya held her cloth doll close to her chest and listened with sleepy eyes till the very end of the tale, when she yawned and went to sleep with a small smile.

payload.title: Sister Reads to Kabir
payload.text: Big sister Anjali sat next to Kabir on the soft sofa in the living room and read a story aloud about a brave bird who flew to a far city. Kabir followed each picture with his small soft finger and asked her what every new word in the book meant. Anjali smiled and explained the words slowly to him as they finished each colourful page.

payload.title: Priya's Story Circle
payload.text: Priya sat in the school story circle on the soft red mat in the corner of the class. She listened to her teacher read a tale about a helpful boy from a small village near the river. She loved the part where the boy shared his lunch with a hungry friend on the way back home. She talked about the story with her friends on the bus.

payload.title: Veer's Brave Tale Night
payload.text: Veer read a brave tale in his small bedroom on a quiet evening and felt his small heart beat fast. The hero of the tale fought a big storm to save a small girl from her wet, broken boat in the river. Veer closed the book and let out a long, soft breath. He felt very happy and wanted to be brave like the hero one day too.

payload.title: Granny on the Terrace
payload.text: Granny sat on the cool, breezy terrace with Meera and turned the bright pages of a kind, old story book that she had read as a child. Meera asked so many small questions after every line that Granny had to stop and smile at her sweet voice. They sat for hours till Father called them in for hot dal, rice, and a warm chapati for dinner.

payload.title: Aditya's Moral Story
payload.text: Aditya heard a moral story from his class teacher about a small boy who shared his lunch with a hungry friend at school. The story told him to be kind to all his friends even on busy and tiring school days when no one was watching him at all. He went back home and told the same story to his little brother on the soft sofa.

payload.title: Tara's New Book
payload.text: Tara picked a new story book from the top home shelf and started reading on the soft, warm rug in her room. The bright pictures and short lines pulled her into a new world full of small brave birds, kind helpful kids, and a small smiling moon that helped a lost girl find the way back home through the cold dark fields late at night.

payload.title: Father Reads to Karan
payload.text: Father sat next to Karan in his bed and read a long hero tale aloud on a cold winter night. The hero of the tale saved a tired old man during a heavy rain at night on a far village road. Karan was so happy with the story that he asked Father to read it just one more time before he closed his small eyes and went to sleep with a smile.

payload.title: Sara at the Library
payload.text: Sara walked into the big city library with her cousin Anaya on a quiet Saturday morning. They both picked colourful story books from the kids corner and sat on the soft blue chairs near the window to read till Mother came back for them in the afternoon. They liked the same book about a kind girl and they read it together once more.

payload.title: Anaya's Funny Tale
payload.text: Anaya read a funny tale at home on the soft rug in her bedroom and laughed so much that Mother came to peek into her room. They sat together on the rug and read the same tale once more so Mother could laugh too at the silly part with the funny dog. Anaya then told Father the same tale during dinner and he laughed loudly at the end.

payload.title: Arjun on the Big Sofa
payload.text: Arjun opened a big story book on the long sofa in the living room and read each line slowly and with full focus. He felt very happy when the small boy in the story finally found his lost dog after a long, hard search through the busy town. He showed the last picture to his big sister and she gave him a small high five for his slow reading.

payload.title: Ishaan's Bedtime Tale
payload.text: Mother sat near Ishaan in his small bed and read a kind tale at bedtime on a calm winter night. The tale was about a small bird that found a new warm home in the courtyard of an old house after the cold and rainy winter days had finally come to a soft end. Ishaan closed his eyes slowly as Mother turned the last bright page of the book.

payload.title: Riya's Picture Story Book
payload.text: Riya looked at the picture story book with bright pages on her soft, warm bed on a slow rainy afternoon. The small mouse in the story made her laugh and she said she wanted to draw the same mouse on her drawing pad later that evening. Mother said it was a lovely idea and offered to keep the drawing safe in her best book of art.

payload.title: Granny Reads to Vikram
payload.text: Granny sat on the cool, breezy porch with Vikram one evening and read a kind story about a helpful boy from a small mountain village. Vikram listened with wide eyes and then asked her to read the same lovely tale once more before dinner. Granny smiled and read the tale once again with a softer voice as the porch grew dim in the late light.

payload.title: Sneha's Story Box
payload.text: Sneha opened the small wooden story box at home and picked the tale with the brightest cover she could see. She sat with Mother on the soft floor rug and read each page slowly to make the small joy of the tale last a little bit longer. Mother held her on her lap and pointed at the pictures and Sneha repeated every new word with a soft smile.

payload.title: Father and Anjali Read
payload.text: Father sat on the long sofa in the living room and read a kind tale aloud to Anjali after dinner. She held her favourite cloth doll close to her chest and listened with a small soft smile till the story moved to the happy end where all the friends became friends again and shared a big bowl of sweet rice with a smiling old village woman.

payload.title: Ravi at Society Pool
payload.text: Ravi jumped into the cool society pool on a hot summer afternoon and made a big splash that wet his cousin Aarav from head to foot. Aarav laughed and splashed him back from the side. Both of them then played a soft water tag near the shallow end of the pool for a long time till Aunt called them out for a small snack of cold ice cream.

payload.title: Anjali's First Swim Class
payload.text: Anjali had her very first swim lesson at the school pool on a bright sunny day with three other kids from her class. The kind coach showed her how to float on her back, how to kick her legs slowly, and how to hold her breath under water. Anjali tried very hard and felt very proud at the end of the long class when the coach gave her a small smile.
payload.problem: She wanted to learn to swim

payload.title: Diya in Lane Puddle
payload.text: Diya saw a big round puddle on the lane after a long heavy rain on the way home from the school van. She jumped right in and made a big splash that wet her school shoes and her white school socks. Mother smiled at the gate and asked her to come inside and change her wet clothes quickly before she sat on the soft sofa to drink her warm milk.

payload.title: River Bath in the Village
payload.text: Aarav had a long, happy bath in the village river with Uncle on a warm afternoon during the summer holidays. The water was cool and the round, smooth stones felt soft under his small bare feet. He saw small fish swim past his ankles slowly and laughed when a small one came to nibble at his toes. Uncle helped him climb back to the bank.

payload.title: Porch Bucket Splash Game
payload.text: Sneha filled a small plastic bucket at the porch tap and tipped it on her cousin's head during the summer holidays. They both laughed loudly and ran back to fill the bucket once more together. The porch floor became very wet and they had to clean it up with a small mop before Mother saw and asked them to be a bit more careful next time around.

payload.title: Kabir's Garden Water Bag
payload.text: Kabir threw a soft water bag at his cousin in the courtyard garden during the summer holidays. The bag burst on his cousin's back and water flew in all directions in the bright sun. Both boys laughed and started filling new water bags for the next round of the game while Uncle watched them from his chair on the porch and smiled at their joy.

payload.title: Priya with Her Friends
payload.text: Priya jumped into the school pool with her three close friends right after the swim coach blew the whistle for free time. They played a soft tag game in the shallow end of the pool and then floated on their backs side by side under the bright noon sun. Priya felt very happy and asked her friends if they could come back to the pool the next day too.

payload.title: Veer by the Village Pond
payload.text: Veer sat by the quiet village pond on a warm afternoon and slowly dipped his small toes in the cool water. A small fish slipped past his foot and he let out a small soft laugh. Uncle sat next to him on the soft mud and read a quiet news paper on the bench. They sat there together for over an hour till the sun started to dip low in the sky.

payload.title: Meera's Long Happy Bath
payload.text: Meera filled the bath bucket and took a long, happy bath at home after a very hot summer day. She poured warm water on her head with a small silver mug and sang a soft song to her cloth doll that sat on the side of the bath tub. Mother came in once to check on her and smiled at her happy face before she went back to the kitchen for dinner.

payload.title: Aditya Sees the Beach
payload.text: Aditya saw the waves at the sea beach for the very first time on a school holiday trip with his family. He held Father's strong hand tightly as the small white waves rushed up to his ankles. He picked up a smooth, round shell from the wet sand to take back home and show Mother. Father took a small picture of him with the shell on the beach.

payload.title: Tara's Courtyard Splash
payload.text: Tara opened a soft water bag in the courtyard with her cousin on a hot summer day during the holidays. The water burst out and they ran around the courtyard laughing in big, happy circles till Mother called them in for a glass of cold lemon water. They sat on the porch and drank the cold drink and asked if they could play once more in the evening.

payload.title: Karan Wins Pool Race
payload.text: Karan won a short pool race against his cousin Veer at the society pool on a bright Saturday morning. He cheered loudly and splashed water with both hands as he reached the wall first. Veer laughed too and asked for one more race after a small rest near the side of the pool. They had three more races before Aunt called them out for a cold treat.

payload.title: Sara's Long Pool Play
payload.text: Sara splashed in the cool pool for a long time with her cousin Anaya on a bright sunny day. They both made a small water wall by kicking their legs together near the side of the pool and then made a tall sand castle on the wet floor near the pool. They played till their fingers and toes turned a soft white from the long time in the water.

payload.title: Anaya Tips the Bucket
payload.text: Anaya tipped a big yellow bucket on her own head at the porch tap on a hot summer afternoon. She laughed loudly as the cool water ran down her hair and her back. She went straight to fill the bucket up once more for one more big splash. Mother came out to the porch and joined her with a smaller bucket for a small water game on the porch.

payload.title: Arjun Watches Beach Waves
payload.text: Arjun watched the slow waves at the sea beach with Father on a warm bright evening. They both held smooth, round shells in their hands and counted each big wave that broke on the wet sand near their bare and very happy feet. Father told him a small story about a fish who lived in the deep sea, and Arjun listened with full eyes and a wide smile.

payload.title: Ishaan at Garden Tap
payload.text: Ishaan splashed water at the garden tap and got his cotton shirt fully wet on a hot summer afternoon. Mother came out to the porch and asked him to be a little careful so that he would not slip on the wet, slippery garden tiles. Ishaan said sorry and went to dry himself with a soft towel. He then went inside to change into a dry blue cotton shirt.

payload.title: Riya on Pool Tube
payload.text: Riya floated on a bright soft tube in the society pool on a calm and bright sunny day. She let her small hands drift on top of the cool water as the warm sun shone bright above her face and dried her cheeks slowly. Her best friend Tara floated next to her and they both talked about their summer plans till Aunt called them in for a hot lunch.

payload.title: Vikram at Village Tap
payload.text: Vikram splashed his hands at the village tap with his cousin on a warm afternoon and laughed loudly. His blue cotton shirt got a little wet but he did not mind at all. Uncle smiled at the gate and said the cool water was good to play with on such a hot summer day. The two cousins played at the tap till Uncle called them in for a small cold drink.

payload.title: Anjali's Happy Bath
payload.text: Anjali poured the bath bucket on her own head at home after a long day of play in the bright park. The water was warm and she sang a soft song to her doll while she splashed her small feet in the warm bath water. Mother smiled at her from the door and told her she would lay out her soft cotton pyjamas on the bed for her to wear after the bath.

payload.title: Ravi at the Village River
payload.text: Ravi went to the village river with Uncle for a fun swim on a warm bright afternoon during the school holidays. The cool water felt fresh and the small fish moved around his small feet. He splashed Uncle once on his face and they both laughed loudly under the open blue sky. Uncle held his hand on the way back to the village home for a hot lunch.

payload.title: Sneha on Cold Day
payload.text: On a cold December day, Sneha wore a thick wool sweater and a soft pink wool cap before she stepped out for school. She still felt the small chill in her hands and ran inside to the warm bright kitchen, where Mother held her small hands and rubbed them slowly to warm them up. Mother also gave her a small glass of warm milk before she left for the bus.

payload.title: Foggy Road to Van Stop
payload.text: Ravi could barely see the foggy road from the front gate of the building on a cold December morning. He held Father's strong hand tightly as they walked slowly to the school van stop near the small park. The fog was so thick that the street lights looked like small soft yellow balls. Father told him a small joke to make him laugh on the slow, careful walk.

payload.title: Anjali Drinks Hot Milk
payload.text: Anjali drank a hot milk glass in the warm bright kitchen on a cold winter morning before school. Her small hands felt very cold and she held the warm glass tightly with both hands to warm them up before she stepped out to the cold porch for the bus. Mother gave her a small kiss on her forehead and a soft pat on her back before she ran to the gate.

payload.title: Aarav's Wool Cap and Scarf
payload.text: Aarav wore a thick wool cap, a long warm scarf, and his warm new gloves for a cold morning walk to the school bus stop. His small nose still felt very cold and he ran back home to ask Mother for a small cup of warm milk before he went to school. Mother smiled and gave him the milk and rubbed his cold hands till they felt warm again.

payload.title: Diya Under the Quilt
payload.text: Diya hugged the warm quilt and stayed in the bed all morning during the cold winter holidays. Mother said she could read her new story book and have a cup of warm milk under the quilt if she wanted to. Diya smiled and turned the bright pages slowly. She read the same book for over an hour and then went to the kitchen to help Mother with the dishes.

payload.title: Kabir Sees Snow
payload.text: Kabir saw real soft white snow for the very first time on a holiday trip to the cool hills with his family. He scooped a small round ball of snow with his thick warm gloves and showed it to his big sister, who laughed and made a small smiling snowman with him on the path near the small hotel. They built three more small snowmen by the side of the road.

payload.title: Priya's New Pink Coat
payload.text: Priya wore her new pink coat to school for the very first time on a cold winter morning during the December holidays. The other kids in the bus said the coat looked very nice and very bright and she felt very happy and proud. She wore the coat the whole day, even inside the warm class, and her best friend asked if she could try it on too at lunch.

payload.title: Veer in the Foggy Lane
payload.text: Veer walked very slowly in the foggy lane near the front gate of the building on a cold winter morning. He held Father's strong hand and could only see a few small steps ahead of him at any one time. The street lights along the road looked like soft yellow balls in the thick white fog and the cold air made his small nose turn a soft red.

payload.title: Meera and Mother Drink Tea
payload.text: Mother gave Meera a small warm tea cup on the cold terrace one foggy winter morning. They sat side by side on the small wooden bench and watched the soft white fog lift slowly from the sleepy city below them. Meera felt very warm and very loved and asked Mother to tell her a small story from her own childhood days in the small village.

payload.title: Aditya's Red Scarf
payload.text: Aditya tied a soft red wool scarf around his neck and stepped out to play with his friends in the park near home. The cold winter wind blew strong and he was very glad about the scarf, which kept his small chest and his neck very warm during the long game with his friends. He came home with a soft pink nose and a wide smile on his face.

payload.title: Tara's Lazy Morning
payload.text: Tara stayed under a warm soft blanket all morning during the cold winter holidays and read her new story book with bright pages. Mother brought her a small warm cup of milk in bed and Tara felt very cosy and very lucky on the cold day. She read till lunch and then went to the kitchen to help Mother make hot dal and soft chapati for the family.

payload.title: Karan Makes Snowman
payload.text: Karan wore a thick snow hat and warm wool gloves at the hill station on a bright snowy day. He made a small smiling snowman with his big sister near the road in front of the small hotel they had booked for the trip. The snow was soft and white and it stayed in big patches on the road sides and on the small green trees near the hotel gate.

payload.title: Sara's Brown Coat
payload.text: Sara wore a warm brown coat on a cold winter morning before she stepped out for school with her big brother. She also wore her warm wool gloves and a soft yellow wool cap that her grandmother had made for her in the village last winter holiday. Sara felt very warm and very loved as she walked to the school bus stop with her brother that morning.

payload.title: Anaya at the Window
payload.text: Anaya could barely see the misty park bench from her seat at the bedroom window on a cold winter morning. The whole city looked like it was wrapped in a soft white cloud. She drew a small smiling face on the foggy glass with her small finger and showed the drawing to her little brother. He laughed and drew a small dog next to her smiling face.

payload.title: Arjun Drinks Hot Drink
payload.text: Arjun had a small cup of hot drink at home before he stepped out to the cold bus stop on a foggy morning. His small hands felt very warm again and his small cheeks turned a soft pink. He waved at Mother from the gate as the school bus came in. Mother waved back and blew him a small kiss before she went inside to start the day at home.

payload.title: Ishaan's Pink Scarf Day
payload.text: Ishaan got a soft pink wool scarf from Aunt last week and wore it on the cold walk to the school van stop today. He felt very warm under the scarf and his big brother told him that pink was a very brave colour to wear to school. Ishaan smiled and said his Aunt had told him the same thing when she gave him the scarf as a small early birthday gift.

payload.title: Riya Reads Under Quilt
payload.text: Riya read her new story book under the warm quilt all afternoon during the cold winter holidays at home. The room was warm and bright and she had a small cup of hot milk on the side table near the bed. She turned the bright pages slowly and smiled at the kind story. Mother came in twice to check on her and to give her a fresh cup of warm milk.

payload.title: Vikram Mountain Trip
payload.text: Vikram went on a big mountain trip with his whole family during the cold school holidays. He saw soft white snow on the trees and on the road sides near the small hotel. He made a small smiling snowman with his big sister and felt very happy as he played in the cool snow. He took a small picture of the snowman with Father's phone to show his friends.

payload.title: Anjali Warm Layer
payload.text: Anjali put on a thick warm layer at home before the school van came on a cold foggy winter morning. She also wore her soft wool cap and her warm blue gloves. Mother kissed her cheek and waved at her from the gate as the van pulled away from the building. Anjali waved back from the window seat of the van and sang a small soft song with her best friend.

payload.title: Ravi Hot Soup at Home
payload.text: Ravi had a hot soup bowl at home after he came back from school on a very cold winter day. The warm soup made his cold hands and his small face feel much better. Mother sat near him on the small kitchen stool and told him a small joke that made him laugh out loud. He finished the soup, asked for one more bowl, and then went off to read his book.

payload.title: Sneha's Sweet Mango
payload.text: Sneha got a sweet ripe mango from the kitchen for her lunch on a hot summer afternoon. She sat on the cool porch and ate the mango slice by slice with a small fork. The sweet mango juice ran down her fingers and she laughed loudly. Mother came out with a small towel to wipe her hands and to give her a glass of cold lemon water from the kitchen.

payload.title: Ravi's Cold Ice Cream
payload.text: Ravi had a cold ice cream at the local shop after a long, hot walk back from the small park near his home. The bright orange cone made him very happy and he ate it fast before it could drip down on his school uniform shirt under the warm summer sun. He waved at his best friend across the road and ran home for a glass of cool lemon water.

payload.title: Anjali in Porch Shade
payload.text: Anjali stayed in the cool shade of the porch on a very hot summer afternoon during the school holidays. Mother brought her a big glass of cold lemon water with a slice of fresh lemon on top. The cold drink made her feel cool and fresh from the inside out. She sat on the swing on the porch and read her new story book under the cool ceiling fan.

payload.title: Aarav Under Mango Tree
payload.text: Aarav sat under the big mango tree in the courtyard for a small bit of cool shade on a hot summer day. The wide green leaves moved softly in the warm summer wind and the small mangoes on the branches looked like bright yellow gifts hanging in the air. He looked up at the tree and tried to see how many mangoes he could spot from his small spot.

payload.title: Diya's Lemon Water
payload.text: Diya drank a big glass of cold lemon water after she came home from school on a hot summer day. Mother had kept the glass ready on the kitchen table with a small slice of fresh lemon on top. She drank it slowly and felt very cool from the inside. She also asked for a second small glass before she went to change into her cool home clothes.

payload.title: Kabir's Mango Bowl
payload.text: Kabir got a big mango bowl from Mother in the bright kitchen on a hot summer day. He sat at the small wooden table and ate it slowly with a tiny silver fork. He saved the last sweet slice for his big brother to eat after the bath. Mother smiled at him and gave him one more small slice from her own plate as a sweet little summer treat for him.

payload.title: Priya at AC Mall
payload.text: Priya had a cold treat at the AC mall after a long, hot day of school and shopping. The big AC and the cold sweet treat made her feel very new again. She sat with Mother near the fountain and smiled as the cold air dried her face. They sat there for over an hour before they went home in the bright orange evening of the long hot summer day.

payload.title: Veer in Sunny Field
payload.text: Veer played in the bright sunny field till his small cheeks turned a soft, warm red on a hot summer day. His big sister called him in for a glass of cold lemon water before he could play even more in the bright sun and tire himself out by the end of the day. He drank the lemon water in one go and asked her for one more glass before he sat down.

payload.title: Meera in Garden Shade
payload.text: Meera sat in the cool shade of the big garden umbrella and sipped a big glass of cold lemon juice on a hot summer day. The big umbrella kept the bright summer sun off her face all afternoon. She read her new story book and felt very happy in the cool shade. Mother came out twice to check on her and to give her fresh glasses of cool lemon juice.

payload.title: Aditya's Cold Drink
payload.text: Aditya had a tall glass of cold drink at home after the long, hot walk back from school on a summer day. His school uniform shirt was wet with small drops of sweat and his face was a soft red colour. He drank the cold drink in one go and asked for one more glass right away. Mother smiled and made a fresh glass with a slice of lemon on top.

payload.title: Tara's Mango Pulp Bowl
payload.text: Tara loved the sweet mango pulp bowl Mother made at home on a hot summer day during the school holidays. She ate it slowly with a small spoon and saved the very last bit to enjoy at the very end of the meal. The mango pulp was bright yellow and very sweet and very fresh and Tara asked Mother if she could have a second small bowl that night.

payload.title: Karan's Park Cone
payload.text: Karan held a tall, cool cone treat in the park near home on a hot summer day. The ice cream began to drip down the side of the cone and he licked it fast in the bright sun. His big sister laughed and gave him a small paper tissue to wipe his fingers. He sat on the small park bench under the tree to finish the cone in the cool shade slowly.

payload.title: Sara on Sunny Porch
payload.text: Sara saw bright sunshine on the white porch wall on a hot summer afternoon during the school holidays. She made small shapes with her hand and watched the soft shadows dance on the white wall. Mother came out with a small cool glass of cold lemon water for her. They sat together on the porch swing and read a story book under the slow ceiling fan.

payload.title: Anaya Under Umbrella
payload.text: Anaya found a cool spot under the big garden umbrella on a hot summer day during the school holidays. She put her favourite cloth doll on the small bench next to her and read her new story book in the cool shade. She felt very calm and happy in the cool spot under the umbrella. Mother came out with a small plate of mango slices for her too.

payload.title: Arjun's Lemon Glass
payload.text: Arjun gulped a big glass of cold lemon water at home after he came back from a long play in the field with his friends. He felt very cool from the inside out and asked Mother for one more big glass. Mother smiled and made a fresh glass with a slice of lemon on top. Arjun drank that glass slowly and then went to take a cool bath at home.

payload.title: Ishaan's Mango Lunch
payload.text: Ishaan ate a sweet mango slice with rice and dal for lunch on a hot summer day during the school holidays. He saved the very last slice to eat at the very end of the meal. Mother smiled at him and gave him one more small slice from her own plate as a sweet treat. Ishaan thanked Mother and told her the lunch was the best one he had had all week.

payload.title: Riya's Choco Cone
payload.text: Riya had a big choco treat at the small shop after school on a hot summer day. She held the cone with care so it would not drip down on her white school uniform skirt. Her best friend Tara had a vanilla cone next to her and they both giggled as they ate it slowly. They walked home together and shared a small joke about the funny man at the shop.

payload.title: Vikram on Hot Road
payload.text: Vikram walked under the bright hot sun to the bus stop on a hot summer day during school. He held his school bag over his head to make a small bit of shade for his face. The road felt very hot under his small black school shoes and he walked very fast. At the bus stop, he stood under the big tree for the cool shade till his school bus came along.

payload.title: Anjali on Park Bench
payload.text: Anjali found a shady bench under a big park tree and sat down to rest from the heat on a hot summer afternoon. The wide green leaves blocked the hot afternoon sun very well and a cool breeze came through. She felt very calm and read her book for a long time. Her best friend Sneha came and sat next to her and they read the same book together for an hour.

payload.title: Ravi's Cool Lemon Glass
payload.text: Ravi had a cool glass of lemon water at home and felt very fresh again. Mother added a small drop of honey to make it sweet for him. He sat on the small kitchen stool and drank it slowly while he told Mother all about his day at school and his play at the park. Mother laughed at his small stories and made him one more glass before dinner.

payload.title: Sneha's First Rain
payload.text: Sneha opened her bright pink umbrella for the first rain of the season on the way home from the school bus stop. The big drops made a soft tap-tap sound on top of the umbrella and she felt very happy as she walked through the small puddles on the lane. She splashed in a big puddle near the gate and laughed loudly. Mother smiled at her from the door.

payload.title: Ravi at the Window
payload.text: Ravi watched the rain hit the bedroom window for a very long time on a wet afternoon during the monsoon. The big round drops slid down the glass in slow lines and he made small drawings on the foggy window with his small finger as the rain came down. He drew a small smiling sun and a big round cloud with two big drops of rain on his window.

payload.title: Anjali Hides from Thunder
payload.text: Anjali heard a loud thunder rumble and hid under her bed with her favourite cloth doll. Mother came in and sat near her on the floor and held her hand tightly till the loud sound passed. Anjali felt safe in Mother's arms and the loud storm did not seem so very bad anymore. She slowly came out from under the bed and sat in Mother's lap on the rug.

payload.title: Aarav Floats Paper Boat
payload.text: Aarav made a small paper boat with Father at home one rainy afternoon and went out to let it float in the lane puddle near the gate. The small boat moved slowly with the small flow of rain water and Aarav clapped his small hands when the boat went past the gate. Father took a small picture of him with the boat and sent it to Mother on his phone.

payload.title: Diya's Wet School Shoes
payload.text: Diya's school shoes got fully wet on the way to the school van stop on a rainy morning during the monsoon. Mother dried them with a soft cloth when she got home in the evening and put them near the warm window so they could be ready for school the next day. Diya wore her rain boots the next morning and was glad about the dry shoes by the window.

payload.title: Kabir Counts Rain Drops
payload.text: Kabir watched the falling rain from his bedroom window for over an hour on a wet afternoon during the monsoon. He counted the small lightning flashes in his small note book and made a small chart of the loud thunder times to show his class teacher at school the next day. He felt very proud of his small science chart and showed it to Mother too.

payload.title: Priya and Cat in Storm
payload.text: Priya hid in her bedroom when the loud storm came over the building during a heavy monsoon evening. Her small grey cat sat near her feet on the soft rug and they both listened to the rain together. Mother came in with a warm cup of milk and sat next to her till the storm passed. Priya felt safe with Mother and her cat and slowly fell asleep on the rug.

payload.title: Veer's Blue Raincoat
payload.text: Veer wore his blue raincoat to the school van stop on a wet rainy morning during the monsoon. He also wore his rain boots and held a small umbrella over his school bag. The rain came down very hard and he was very glad that he wore the warm raincoat that day. His friend Karan came up with his red raincoat and they ran to the school van together.

payload.title: Meera Comes Home Wet
payload.text: Meera came home with very wet hair after the school bus dropped her at the front gate of the building on a rainy day. Mother gave her a soft, warm towel and a glass of warm milk. Meera changed into dry, soft, warm clothes and felt very cosy on the wet rainy evening. She sat on the soft sofa and read her new story book by the lamp light.

payload.title: Aditya Sees Big Lightning
payload.text: Aditya saw a big bright lightning flash in the dark grey cloud over the building one rainy evening. He counted slowly to ten and then heard the loud rumble of thunder. He marked the time in his small note book and went back to his story book on the soft sofa. He showed the note book to Father and Father told him a small fact about lightning.

payload.title: Tara's Pink Umbrella
payload.text: Tara held a bright pink umbrella on the way to the school bus stop on a rainy morning during the monsoon. The strong wind tried to flip the umbrella but she held the small handle very tight. She also wore her rain boots and felt very brave on the long wet walk to the bus stop. The bus came on time and she sat next to her best friend Anaya in the bus.

payload.title: Karan's Wet School Van
payload.text: Karan's school van got fully wet in the heavy rain on the way to school. The driver had to wipe the wet seats with a small cloth before all the kids could sit in their seats. The trip to school was very slow because of the rain but Karan looked out the window at the wet city the whole time. He saw small kids splash in big puddles on the road.

payload.title: Sara Sits Through Storm
payload.text: Sara stayed inside as the loud storm rolled over the building one rainy evening. She read her favourite story book and sipped a warm cup of milk. Father sat next to her on the soft sofa and told her small fun stories from his school days till the storm passed slowly. Sara liked the funny story about the goat that ate Father's school bag and laughed loudly at it.

payload.title: Anaya's New Umbrella
payload.text: Anaya got a bright new umbrella from Mother that morning before school during the monsoon season. She could not wait for the rain to start so she could try the new umbrella on the way home. By the time school was over, the sky was a dark grey and the rain had started to fall. She opened her new umbrella with a big proud smile and ran to the gate.

payload.title: Arjun on Village Mud Path
payload.text: Arjun made a big mud splash on the village mud path during the school holidays at the small village. His small shoes got fully brown but he laughed loudly and kept on going through the wet path. Uncle called him to come back and wash his shoes at the village tap before he stepped into the small house. Arjun ran to the tap and washed off the brown mud.

payload.title: Watchman Closes Gate
payload.text: The watchman closed the society gate as the loud storm grew even louder. He waved at the kids and told them to go inside the building fast and not to play in the lane. The kids ran up the stairs and the watchman pulled his small chair into his small room to wait out the storm. He sipped his warm cup of tea and watched the heavy rain hit the small window.

payload.title: Riya in the Wet Lane
payload.text: Riya walked with a soft pink umbrella down the wet lane to her home after school on a rainy day. The lane had small puddles and she stepped over each one with care. The rain came down softly and she felt very happy as she splashed her rain boots in the larger puddles near the gate. Mother saw her from the porch and waved at her with a happy smile.

payload.title: Vikram in the Drizzle
payload.text: Vikram felt a light drizzle on his small face as he stepped out of the school van one wet evening. He held his school bag over his head and ran to the gate. The rain made a soft tap-tap sound on the bag and his small black school shoes splashed in a small puddle near the gate. He waved at the watchman and ran up the stairs to his home on the first floor.

payload.title: Anjali Sees Lightning
payload.text: Anjali saw a big bright lightning flash at night from her bedroom window during the heavy monsoon storm. The whole sky lit up for a small second and then everything went back to a dark blue grey. She held her cloth doll tight and waited for the loud thunder rumble to come right after. The thunder came in a few seconds and shook the small window slightly.

payload.title: Ravi's Yellow Raincoat
payload.text: Ravi wore a bright yellow raincoat and skipped down the road to the school bus stop on a rainy morning. The rain drops bounced off his hood with a soft tap-tap sound. He sang a small song under his breath as he skipped to the bus stop. His best friend Aarav came up with his blue raincoat and they sang the small song together as they waited for the bus.

payload.title: Slide Race EPG
payload.text: Aarav and Karan had a small evening tradition. Every day after homework they raced down the two slides at the society playground. On a bright Friday Aarav reached the bottom first and laughed loudly. They climbed up to play again, but this time Karan stepped aside to let his small brother go first. Aarav clapped softly and said it was a really kind thing. They finished the day with one more friendly race together.
payload.problem: Aarav and Karan had a friendly slide race

payload.title: Over the Wall
payload.text: Priya kicked the football very hard during the school playground match. The ball flew right over the high boundary wall and landed in the next plot. She felt a little worried but decided to handle it properly. She walked over to the watchman and explained where the ball had landed. The watchman smiled and went out to fetch it. He brought it back, and Priya thanked him before her team got back to playing.
payload.problem: Priya kicked the ball over the wall

payload.title: Scary Swing EPG
payload.text: Rohan went very high on the swing at the society playground one Sunday afternoon. After a few pushes he felt scared because his hands were slipping. His friend stood near the swing and told him to hold tight and slow his legs. Rohan calmed himself, gripped the chains harder and slowly came back down safely. He sat on the ground for a moment to catch his breath. He smiled and said he would still try the swing again next time.
payload.problem: Rohan got scared on a high swing

payload.title: Sand Tower EPG
payload.text: Diya and Meera worked together to build a tall sand tower at the playground. They patted the sand carefully and added decorations on top. A small kid ran past and broke the tower by mistake. Both girls felt sad for a moment but Diya quickly said it was just an accident. They started again and made an even bigger and stronger tower than the first one. The small kid joined in to help them this time.

payload.title: Balance Trick
payload.text: Kabir sat on the see-saw with his much smaller friend at the society playground one evening. Because Kabir was heavier his side stayed pinned to the ground while his friend's side went up. The two looked at each other and laughed. The teacher came over and showed them how to lean forward and back at the right times to balance the see-saw. After a few tries they got the see-saw moving smoothly up and down.
payload.problem: Kabir's side of the see-saw was too heavy

payload.title: Long Hide
payload.text: Anaya hid behind the big slide at the playground during a game of hide and seek. She crouched low and stayed completely still. Her friends searched everywhere for what felt like a long time and could not find her. Finally Anaya came out laughing when she heard them calling her name across the playground. Her friends ran over and patted her on the back. They told her she had won the round fairly and asked her to be the seeker next.
payload.problem: Anaya hid too well to be found

payload.title: Tag Rule EPG
payload.text: Aditya was playing tag at the school playground when a small argument started. His friend said the tag had not really counted and Aditya thought it had. Both boys looked upset for a moment. Aditya then took a deep breath and offered to restart the round to make it fair. His friend smiled and agreed. They made a clear new rule together about what counts as a real tag and went back to playing happily.
payload.problem: Aditya solved a tag argument fairly

payload.title: Hopscotch Champ EPG
payload.text: Meera and Tara played hopscotch at the playground after school. They drew the squares with white chalk on the cement near the swings. Meera hopped on every square without ever touching the lines and finished the full round perfectly. Tara clapped for her and said she really wanted to try too. They took turns until the sun went down. Both girls walked home tired but very happy with their long hopscotch session.

payload.title: Scraped Knee EPG
payload.text: Ishaan was running fast on the sand at the playground after school. He did not see a hidden stone in his path and tripped over it. He scraped his knee on the rough ground and felt a small sting. The teacher came right away, washed the cut with clean water and put a small bandage on it. After a short rest Ishaan was back to playing tag with his friends as if nothing had happened.
payload.problem: Ishaan tripped and scraped his knee

payload.title: Tree Climb EPG
payload.text: Sara climbed a small tree at the playground because she wanted to see how high she could go. She got stuck on a thin branch and could not figure out how to climb down safely. Her friend saw her up there and ran to call the teacher. The teacher arrived with a small stool and stood right under the branch. She gently guided Sara step by step until both her feet touched the ground.
payload.problem: Sara got stuck on a tree branch

payload.title: Muddy Field
payload.text: Arjun ran across the village ground after a heavy morning rain. The mud was soft and slippery and his feet kept sliding. He slipped on a wet patch and fell flat on his back. His clothes got dirty but he laughed at himself instead of crying. His friends helped him up and brushed off his shirt. They all played football carefully for the rest of the evening, watching out for the slippery spots together.
payload.problem: Arjun slipped in the wet mud

payload.title: Friends Late
payload.text: Ravi reached the village ground in the evening but his friends had not arrived yet. He kicked a small stone around to pass the time. Slowly his friends came one by one with their bats, balls and water bottles. They quickly picked teams and decided who would bat first. They played a short but exciting cricket match until the sun started going down. They walked home talking about the best shots of the day.
payload.problem: Ravi waited alone for his friends

payload.title: Wet Slide EPG
payload.text: Tara reached the playground in the morning and saw that the slide was wet from the rain the night before. The smaller kids were already running over to play and Tara knew they might slip. She quickly took a clean cloth from her bag and wiped the slide from the top all the way down. Then she let the smaller kids slide first. The kids cheered and Tara felt happy that she had helped keep them safe.
payload.problem: The slide was wet and unsafe

payload.title: Push Brother
payload.text: Karan was at the society playground with his small brother on a Sunday evening. His brother wanted to ride the swing but was too small to push himself off. Karan stood behind the swing and pushed gently every time it came back. His brother giggled loudly and kept asking for one more push every single time. They stayed at the swing for nearly an hour before walking home together for dinner.
payload.problem: Karan pushed the swing for his brother

payload.title: Cheer Up EPG
payload.text: Riya noticed Sneha sitting alone on the playground bench in the afternoon and looking very sad. She walked over and gently asked her what was wrong. Sneha said no one had wanted to play hopscotch with her that day. Riya smiled warmly and said she would love to play together. They drew the squares with chalk and played hopscotch until the sun was low in the sky. Sneha looked much happier by the end.
payload.problem: Riya cheered up a sad friend

payload.title: High Catch EPG
payload.text: Veer was fielding deep at the school playground during a cricket match. The batter swung hard and the ball flew very high into the sky. Veer kept his eye on the ball, ran back a few steps and got under it. He caught it cleanly with both hands at chest height. His teammates rushed over to give him high fives and patted him on the back. The coach said it was the best catch of the day.
payload.problem: Veer caught a high ball cleanly

payload.title: Heat Rest
payload.text: Ananya was running around the playground in the hot afternoon sun. After a while she started feeling dizzy and her face turned red. Her friend noticed and told her to sit down in the shade right away. Ananya walked over to a big tree and slowly sank down. She drank water from her bottle and rested for ten minutes. After the short rest she felt much better and went back to play carefully.
payload.problem: Ananya felt dizzy in the heat

payload.title: Brave Jump EPG
payload.text: Sneha stood at the top of the slide at the playground feeling scared to jump off the side ledge. Her friends had done it before but she had always slid down instead. Her best friend stood at the bottom and told her she could do it. Sneha took a deep breath, counted to three in her head and finally jumped down safely onto the soft sand. She felt very proud and ran straight back up to do it again.
payload.problem: Sneha bravely jumped from the slide

payload.title: Let Kid Go EPG
payload.text: Anjali was waiting in a long line for the slide at the playground after school. A small kid joined the line behind her and was bouncing with excitement. Anjali smiled, stepped aside and gestured for the small kid to go first. The small kid grinned and ran ahead. The kid's mother walked over and thanked Anjali warmly for being so kind. Anjali went down the slide a moment later feeling very happy with her choice.
payload.problem: Anjali let a smaller kid go first

payload.title: Bee Calm EPG
payload.text: Vikram was sitting on the swing at the playground when a bee began to circle close to his head. He felt scared but remembered what his friend had once told him. He froze and stayed completely still as the bee flew round and round him. After a long minute the bee lost interest and flew away towards the flowers. Vikram got off the swing slowly and walked over to his friend to thank him for the tip.
payload.problem: Vikram stayed calm when a bee circled him

payload.title: Sun and Bird
